WITH active_org AS (
    SELECT * FROM staging.stg_workday__organization WHERE is_inactive = FALSE
), assignments AS (
    SELECT wpo.worker_id, wpo.position_id, wpo.organization_id, wpo.source_relation,
           wpo.effective_start, wpo.effective_end,
           p.employee_type, p.default_weekly_hours, jp.management_level, jp.compensation_grade_id,
           jp.is_work_shift_required, jp.is_union_eligible, jf.job_family_id, jfg.job_family_group_id
    FROM staging.stg_workday__worker_position_organization AS wpo
    LEFT JOIN staging.stg_workday__position AS p ON wpo.position_id=p.position_id
    LEFT JOIN staging.stg_workday__position_job_profile AS pjp ON p.position_id=pjp.position_id AND p.source_relation=pjp.source_relation
    LEFT JOIN staging.stg_workday__job_profile AS jp ON pjp.job_profile_id=jp.job_profile_id AND pjp.source_relation=jp.source_relation
    LEFT JOIN staging.stg_workday__job_family_job_profile AS jfjp ON jp.job_profile_id=jfjp.job_profile_id AND jp.source_relation=jfjp.source_relation
    LEFT JOIN staging.stg_workday__job_family AS jf ON jfjp.job_family_id=jf.job_family_id AND jfjp.source_relation=jf.source_relation
    LEFT JOIN staging.stg_workday__job_family_job_family_group AS jfjg ON jf.job_family_id=jfjg.job_family_id AND jf.source_relation=jfjg.source_relation
    LEFT JOIN staging.stg_workday__job_family_group AS jfg ON jfjg.job_family_group_id=jfg.job_family_group_id AND jfjg.source_relation=jfg.source_relation
), current_stats AS (
 SELECT organization_id, source_relation, count(DISTINCT worker_id) current_employee_count,
 count(DISTINCT position_id) total_positions,
 count(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE employee_type='Regular') regular_employees,
 count(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE employee_type='Contingent') contingent_employees,
 count(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE employee_type='Intern') intern_employees,
 coalesce(avg(coalesce(default_weekly_hours,40)),40)::DOUBLE avg_weekly_hours,
 coalesce(sum(coalesce(default_weekly_hours,40)),0)::HUGEINT total_weekly_hours,
 count(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE management_level='Manager') managers_count,
 count(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE management_level='Senior Manager') senior_managers_count,
 count(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE management_level='Director') directors_count,
 count(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE management_level='Individual Contributor') individual_contributors,
 count(DISTINCT compensation_grade_id) unique_compensation_grades,
 count(DISTINCT job_family_id) unique_job_families,count(DISTINCT job_family_group_id) unique_job_family_groups,
 count(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE is_work_shift_required) shift_required_positions,
 count(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE is_union_eligible) union_eligible_positions,
 avg(date_diff('day',effective_start,coalesce(effective_end,current_date))) avg_tenure_days
 FROM assignments WHERE effective_end IS NULL GROUP BY organization_id,source_relation
), mobility AS (
 SELECT a.organization_id,a.source_relation,
 count(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE effective_start >= current_date - INTERVAL '1 year') new_hires_last_year,
 count(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE effective_end >= current_date - INTERVAL '1 year') departures_last_year,
 count(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE effective_start >= current_date - INTERVAL '1 year' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM assignments x WHERE x.worker_id=a.worker_id AND x.source_relation=a.source_relation AND x.organization_id<>a.organization_id AND x.effective_start<a.effective_start)) internal_transfers_in,
 count(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE effective_end >= current_date - INTERVAL '1 year' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM assignments x WHERE x.worker_id=a.worker_id AND x.source_relation=a.source_relation AND x.organization_id<>a.organization_id AND x.effective_start>a.effective_end)) internal_transfers_out
 FROM assignments a GROUP BY organization_id,source_relation
), grade_freq AS (
 SELECT organization_id,source_relation,compensation_grade_id,
 row_number() over(partition by organization_id,source_relation order by count(*) desc, compensation_grade_id asc) rn
 FROM assignments WHERE effective_end IS NULL AND compensation_grade_id IS NOT NULL
 GROUP BY organization_id,source_relation,compensation_grade_id
)
SELECT o.organization_id,o.source_relation,o.organization_name,o.organization_code,o.organization_type,o.organization_sub_type,o.staffing_model,
 coalesce(c.current_employee_count,0)::BIGINT current_employee_count,coalesce(c.total_positions,0)::BIGINT total_positions,
 coalesce(c.regular_employees,0)::BIGINT regular_employees,coalesce(c.contingent_employees,0)::BIGINT contingent_employees,coalesce(c.intern_employees,0)::BIGINT intern_employees,
 coalesce(c.avg_weekly_hours,40)::DOUBLE avg_weekly_hours,coalesce(c.total_weekly_hours,0)::HUGEINT total_weekly_hours,
 coalesce(c.managers_count,0)::BIGINT managers_count,coalesce(c.senior_managers_count,0)::BIGINT senior_managers_count,coalesce(c.directors_count,0)::BIGINT directors_count,coalesce(c.individual_contributors,0)::BIGINT individual_contributors,
 coalesce(m.new_hires_last_year,0)::BIGINT new_hires_last_year,coalesce(m.departures_last_year,0)::BIGINT departures_last_year,
 coalesce(m.internal_transfers_in,0)::BIGINT internal_transfers_in,coalesce(m.internal_transfers_out,0)::BIGINT internal_transfers_out,
 coalesce(c.avg_tenure_days,0)::DOUBLE avg_tenure_days,coalesce(c.unique_compensation_grades,0)::BIGINT unique_compensation_grades,
 coalesce(g.compensation_grade_id,'Unknown')::VARCHAR most_common_grade,coalesce(c.unique_job_families,0)::BIGINT unique_job_families,coalesce(c.unique_job_family_groups,0)::BIGINT unique_job_family_groups,
 coalesce(c.shift_required_positions,0)::BIGINT shift_required_positions,coalesce(c.union_eligible_positions,0)::BIGINT union_eligible_positions,
 CASE WHEN coalesce(c.current_employee_count,0)=0 THEN 0 ELSE
 (20 + CASE WHEN coalesce(m.departures_last_year,0)*1.0/c.current_employee_count<0.2 THEN 20 ELSE 0 END+
 CASE WHEN c.managers_count*1.0/c.current_employee_count BETWEEN .1 AND .3 THEN 20 ELSE 0 END+
 CASE WHEN c.unique_job_families>=2 THEN 20 ELSE 0 END+CASE WHEN c.avg_tenure_days>=365 THEN 20 ELSE 0 END)::INTEGER END organization_health_score,
 CASE WHEN coalesce(c.total_positions,0)>0 THEN round(c.current_employee_count*100.0/c.total_positions,2) ELSE 0 END::DOUBLE position_fill_rate,
 CASE WHEN coalesce(c.current_employee_count,0)>0 THEN round(coalesce(m.departures_last_year,0)*100.0/c.current_employee_count,2) ELSE 0 END::DOUBLE annual_turnover_rate,
 CASE WHEN coalesce(c.current_employee_count,0)>0 THEN round(coalesce(c.managers_count,0)*100.0/c.current_employee_count,2) ELSE 0 END::DOUBLE management_ratio,
 CASE WHEN coalesce(c.current_employee_count,0)=0 THEN 'Needs Attention' WHEN c.current_employee_count>0 AND (20+CASE WHEN coalesce(m.departures_last_year,0)*1.0/c.current_employee_count<.2 THEN 20 ELSE 0 END+CASE WHEN c.managers_count*1.0/c.current_employee_count BETWEEN .1 AND .3 THEN 20 ELSE 0 END+CASE WHEN c.unique_job_families>=2 THEN 20 ELSE 0 END+CASE WHEN c.avg_tenure_days>=365 THEN 20 ELSE 0 END)>=80 THEN 'High Performance'
 WHEN coalesce(c.current_employee_count,0)>0 THEN CASE WHEN (20+CASE WHEN coalesce(m.departures_last_year,0)*1.0/c.current_employee_count<.2 THEN 20 ELSE 0 END+CASE WHEN c.managers_count*1.0/c.current_employee_count BETWEEN .1 AND .3 THEN 20 ELSE 0 END+CASE WHEN c.unique_job_families>=2 THEN 20 ELSE 0 END+CASE WHEN c.avg_tenure_days>=365 THEN 20 ELSE 0 END)>=60 THEN 'Good Performance' WHEN (20+CASE WHEN coalesce(m.departures_last_year,0)*1.0/c.current_employee_count<.2 THEN 20 ELSE 0 END+CASE WHEN c.managers_count*1.0/c.current_employee_count BETWEEN .1 AND .3 THEN 20 ELSE 0 END+CASE WHEN c.unique_job_families>=2 THEN 20 ELSE 0 END+CASE WHEN c.avg_tenure_days>=365 THEN 20 ELSE 0 END)>=40 THEN 'Average Performance' WHEN (20+CASE WHEN coalesce(m.departures_last_year,0)*1.0/c.current_employee_count<.2 THEN 20 ELSE 0 END+CASE WHEN c.managers_count*1.0/c.current_employee_count BETWEEN .1 AND .3 THEN 20 ELSE 0 END+CASE WHEN c.unique_job_families>=2 THEN 20 ELSE 0 END+CASE WHEN c.avg_tenure_days>=365 THEN 20 ELSE 0 END)>=20 THEN 'Below Average' ELSE 'Needs Attention' END END performance_category,
 CASE WHEN coalesce(c.current_employee_count,0)=0 THEN 'Empty' WHEN c.current_employee_count<=10 THEN 'Small Team' WHEN c.current_employee_count<=50 THEN 'Medium Team' WHEN c.current_employee_count<=200 THEN 'Large Team' ELSE 'Enterprise Unit' END organization_size_category,
 CASE WHEN c.current_employee_count<0 THEN 'ERROR' WHEN c.current_employee_count>c.total_positions OR (c.current_employee_count>0 AND coalesce(m.departures_last_year,0)*100.0/c.current_employee_count>100) OR (c.current_employee_count>0 AND coalesce(c.managers_count,0)*100.0/c.current_employee_count>50) THEN 'WARNING' ELSE 'VALID' END data_quality_flag
FROM active_org o LEFT JOIN current_stats c USING(organization_id,source_relation)
LEFT JOIN mobility m USING(organization_id,source_relation)
LEFT JOIN grade_freq g ON o.organization_id=g.organization_id AND o.source_relation=g.source_relation AND g.rn=1

CAST(COALESCE(m.departures_last_year, 0) AS BIGINT) AS departures_last_year, CAST(COALESCE(m.internal_transfers_in, 0) AS BIGINT) AS internal_transfers_in, CAST(COALESCE(m.internal_transfers_out, 0) AS BIGINT) AS internal_transfers_out, CAST(COALESCE(c.avg_tenure_days, 0) AS DOUBLE) AS avg_tenure_days, CAST(COALESCE(c.unique_compensation_grades, 0) AS BIGINT) AS unique_compensation_grades, CAST(COALESCE(g.compensation_grade_id, 'Unknown') AS TEXT) AS most_common_grade, CAST(COALESCE(c.unique_job_families, 0) AS BIGINT) AS unique_job_families, CAST(COALESCE(c.unique_job_family_groups, 0) AS BIGINT) AS unique_job_family_groups, CAST(COALESCE(c.shift_required_positions, 0) AS BIGINT) AS shift_required_positions, CAST(COALESCE(c.union_eligible_positions, 0) AS BIGINT) AS union_eligible_positions, CASE WHEN COALESCE(c.current_employee_count, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE CAST((20 + CASE WHEN COALESCE(m.departures_last_year, 0) * 1.0 / c.current_employee_count < 0.2 THEN 20 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN c.managers_count * 1.0 / c.current_employee_count BETWEEN 0.1 AND 0.3 THEN 20 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN c.unique_job_families >= 2 THEN 20 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN c.avg_tenure_days >= 365 THEN 20 ELSE 0 END) AS INT) END AS organization_health_score, CAST(CASE WHEN COALESCE(c.total_positions, 0) > 0 THEN ROUND(c.current_employee_count * 100.0 / c.total_positions, 2) ELSE 0 END AS DOUBLE) AS position_fill_rate, CAST(CASE WHEN COALESCE(c.current_employee_count, 0) > 0 THEN ROUND(COALESCE(m.departures_last_year, 0) * 100.0 / c.current_employee_count, 2) ELSE 0 END AS DOUBLE) AS annual_turnover_rate, CAST(CASE WHEN COALESCE(c.current_employee_count, 0) > 0 THEN ROUND(COALESCE(c.managers_count, 0) * 100.0 / c.current_employee_count, 2) ELSE 0 END AS DOUBLE) AS management_ratio, CASE WHEN COALESCE(c.current_employee_count, 0) = 0 THEN 'Needs Attention' WHEN c.current_employee_count > 0 AND (20 + CASE WHEN COALESCE(m.departures_last_year, 0) * 1.0 / c.current_employee_count < 0.2 THEN 20 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN c.managers_count * 1.0 / c.current_employee_count BETWEEN 0.1 AND 0.3 THEN 20 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN c.unique_job_families >= 2 THEN 20 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN c.avg_tenure_days >= 365 THEN 20 ELSE 0 END) >= 80 THEN 'High Performance' WHEN COALESCE(c.current_employee_count, 0) > 0 THEN CASE WHEN (20 + CASE WHEN COALESCE(m.departures_last_year, 0) * 1.0 / c.current_employee_count < 0.2 THEN 20 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN c.managers_count * 1.0 / c.current_employee_count BETWEEN 0.1 AND 0.3 THEN 20 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN c.unique_job_families >= 2 THEN 20 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN c.avg_tenure_days >= 365 THEN 20 ELSE 0 END) >= 60 THEN 'Good Performance' WHEN (20 + CASE WHEN COALESCE(m.departures_last_year, 0) * 1.0 / c.current_employee_count < 0.2 THEN 20 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN c.managers_count * 1.0 / c.current_employee_count BETWEEN 0.1 AND 0.3 THEN 20 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN c.unique_job_families >= 2 THEN 20 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN c.avg_tenure_days >= 365 THEN 20 ELSE 0 END) >= 40 THEN 'Average Performance' WHEN (20 + CASE WHEN COALESCE(m.departures_last_year, 0) * 1.0 / c.current_employee_count < 0.2 THEN 20 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN c.managers_count * 1.0 / c.current_employee_count BETWEEN 0.1 AND 0.3 THEN 20 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN c.unique_job_families >= 2 THEN 20 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN c.avg_tenure_days >= 365 THEN 20 ELSE 0 END) >= 20 THEN 'Below Average' ELSE 'Needs Attention' END END AS performance_category, CASE WHEN COALESCE(c.current_employee_count, 0) = 0 THEN 'Empty' WHEN c.current_employee_count <= 10 THEN 'Small Team' WHEN c.current_employee_count <= 50 THEN 'Medium Team' WHEN c.current_employee_count <= 200 THEN 'Large Team' ELSE 'Enterprise Unit' END AS organization_size_category, CASE WHEN c.current_employee_count < 0 THEN 'ERROR' WHEN c.current_employee_count > c.total_positions OR (c.current_employee_count > 0 AND COALESCE(m.departures_last_year, 0) * 100.0 / c.current_employee_count > 100) OR (c.current_employee_count > 0 AND COALESCE(c.managers_count, 0) * 100.0 / c.current_employee_count > 50) THEN 'WARNING' ELSE 'VALID' END AS data_quality_flag FROM active_org AS o LEFT JOIN current_stats AS c USING (organization_id, source_relation) LEFT JOIN mobility AS m USING (organization_id, source_relation) LEFT JOIN grade_freq AS g blocks.original_text:
- name: int_workday__organization_metrics
      description: Organizational health and efficiency metrics aggregated for active Workday organizations
      grain: One row per (organization_id, source_relation) for active organizations (is_inactive = false)
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_workday__organization
      - staging.stg_workday__worker_position_organization
      - staging.stg_workday__position
      - staging.stg_workday__position_job_profile
      - staging.stg_workday__job_profile
      - staging.stg_workday__job_family_job_profile
      - staging.stg_workday__job_family
      - staging.stg_workday__job_family_job_family_group
      - staging.stg_workday__job_family_group
      business_logic: 'Build the base set from organizations marked active. Derive current employee distribution from worker-position-organization joined to position and job profile, restricted to current assignments (no end date): count distinct workers and positions; count distinct current workers by employee type (Regular, Contingent, Intern); compute average and total weekly hours treating missing weekly hours as 40 before aggregation; count distinct current workers by management level (Manager, Senior Manager, Director, Individual Contributor). Derive mobility from all assignments (historical and current), grouped by organization and source: new_hires_last_year counts distinct workers whose assignment started in the past year; departures_last_year counts distinct workers whose assignment ended in the past year; internal_transfers_in counts distinct workers who started in the past year and had any earlier assignment in a different organization within the same source; internal_transfers_out counts distinct workers who ended in the past year and had any later assignment in a different organization within the same source; avg_tenure_days averages days between start and end (or start and today if still active). Derive compensation distribution from current assignments: count distinct compensation grades, job families, and job family groups; most_common_grade is the most frequent compensation grade with ties resolved to the smallest grade ID; count distinct current workers whose job requires shift work or is union eligible. Left join all aggregates to the active organizations and apply defaults: counts to 0, most_common_grade to ''Unknown'', avg_weekly_hours to 40 if no current positions, total_weekly_hours to 0. Compute metrics: organization_health_score (0–100) is 0 when there are no current employees; otherwise sum five 20-point checks capped at 100: has employees; turnover (departures_last_year/current employees) below 20%; management share (managers/current employees) between 10% and 30% inclusive; at least two job families; average tenure at least 365 days. Compute ratios rounded to two decimals: position_fill_rate is current employees divided by total positions times 100 when positions exist, else 0; annual_turnover_rate is departures_last_year divided by current employees times 100 when employees exist, else 0; management_ratio is managers divided by current employees times 100 when employees exist, else 0. Classify performance by health score: ≥80 High Performance, ≥60 Good Performance, ≥40 Average Performance, ≥20 Below Average, else Needs Attention. Classify size by current employee count: 0 Empty, ≤10 Small Team, ≤50 Medium Team, ≤200 Large Team, else Enterprise Unit. Set data_quality_flag with precedence: ERROR if employee count is negative; else WARNING if employees exceed positions, or turnover rate >100%, or management ratio >50%; else VALID.'
      columns:
      - name: organization_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Primary grouping key from stg_workday__organization; one row per organization_id + source_relation
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source system identifier propagated from staging tables
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: organization_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Display name copied from stg_workday__organization (may be NULL)
      - name: organization_code
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Organization code copied from stg_workday__organization (may be NULL)
      - name: organization_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Type copied from stg_workday__organization (may be NULL)
      - name: organization_sub_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Sub-type copied from stg_workday__organization (may be NULL)
      - name: staffing_model
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Staffing model copied from stg_workday__organization (may be NULL)
      - name: current_employee_count
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct current workers per organization (assignments with no end date); defaults to 0
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: total_positions
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct current positions per organization (assignments with no end date); defaults to 0
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: regular_employees
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct current workers in positions labeled Regular; defaults to 0
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: contingent_employees
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct current workers in positions labeled Contingent; defaults to 0
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: intern_employees
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct current workers in positions labeled Intern; defaults to 0
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: avg_weekly_hours
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average weekly hours over current positions, treating missing hours as 40; defaults to 40 when no current positions
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: total_weekly_hours
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total weekly hours over current positions, treating missing hours as 40; defaults to 0
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: managers_count
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct current workers with management level Manager; defaults to 0
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: senior_managers_count
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct current workers with management level Senior Manager; defaults to 0
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: directors_count
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct current workers with management level Director; defaults to 0
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: individual_contributors
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct current workers with management level Individual Contributor; defaults to 0
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: new_hires_last_year
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct workers whose assignment started within the past year; defaults to 0
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: departures_last_year
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct workers whose assignment ended within the past year; defaults to 0
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: internal_transfers_in
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct workers who started within the past year and had any earlier assignment in a different organization; defaults to 0
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: internal_transfers_out
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct workers who ended within the past year and had any later assignment in a different organization; defaults to 0
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: avg_tenure_days
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average days from assignment start to end (or to today if active) across all assignments; defaults to 0
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: unique_compensation_grades
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct compensation grades across current positions; defaults to 0
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: most_common_grade
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Most frequent compensation grade across current positions, breaking ties to the smallest grade ID; defaults to 'Unknown'
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: unique_job_families
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct job families across current positions; defaults to 0
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: unique_job_family_groups
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct job family groups across current positions; defaults to 0
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: shift_required_positions
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct current workers whose job profile requires shift work; defaults to 0
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: union_eligible_positions
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct current workers whose job profile is union eligible; defaults to 0
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: organization_health_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Five 20-point checks summed and capped at 100, or 0 when there are no current employees
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: position_fill_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Current employees as a percentage of total positions when positions exist, else 0, rounded to two decimals
      - name: annual_turnover_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Departures in the past year as a percentage of current employees when employees exist, else 0, rounded to two decimals
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: management_ratio
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Managers as a percentage of current employees when employees exist, else 0, rounded to two decimals
        tests:
        - not_null

        data_type: VARCHAR

specification.name: int_workday__organization_metrics
specification.description: Organizational health and efficiency metrics aggregated for active Workday organizations
specification.grain: One row per (organization_id, source_relation) for active organizations (is_inactive = false)
specification.business_logic: Build the base set from organizations marked active. Derive current employee distribution from worker-position-organization joined to position and job profile, restricted to current assignments (no end date): count distinct workers and positions; count distinct current workers by employee type (Regular, Contingent, Intern); compute average and total weekly hours treating missing weekly hours as 40 before aggregation; count distinct current workers by management level (Manager, Senior Manager, Director, Individual Contributor). Derive mobility from all assignments (historical and current), grouped by organization and source: new_hires_last_year counts distinct workers whose assignment started in the past year; departures_last_year counts distinct workers whose assignment ended in the past year; internal_transfers_in counts distinct workers who started in the past year and had any earlier assignment in a different organization within the same source; internal_transfers_out counts distinct workers who ended in the past year and had any later assignment in a different organization within the same source; avg_tenure_days averages days between start and end (or start and today if still active). Derive compensation distribution from current assignments: count distinct compensation grades, job families, and job family groups; most_common_grade is the most frequent compensation grade with ties resolved to the smallest grade ID; count distinct current workers whose job requires shift work or is union eligible. Left join all aggregates to the active organizations and apply defaults: counts to 0, most_common_grade to 'Unknown', avg_weekly_hours to 40 if no current positions, total_weekly_hours to 0. Compute metrics: organization_health_score (0–100) is 0 when there are no current employees; otherwise sum five 20-point checks capped at 100: has employees; turnover (departures_last_year/current employees) below 20%; management share (managers/current employees) between 10% and 30% inclusive; at least two job families; average tenure at least 365 days. Compute ratios rounded to two decimals: position_fill_rate is current employees divided by total positions times 100 when positions exist, else 0; annual_turnover_rate is departures_last_year divided by current employees times 100 when employees exist, else 0; management_ratio is managers divided by current employees times 100 when employees exist, else 0. Classify performance by health score: ≥80 High Performance, ≥60 Good Performance, ≥40 Average Performance, ≥20 Below Average, else Needs Attention. Classify size by current employee count: 0 Empty, ≤10 Small Team, ≤50 Medium Team, ≤200 Large Team, else Enterprise Unit. Set data_quality_flag with precedence: ERROR if employee count is negative; else WARNING if employees exceed positions, or turnover rate >100%, or management ratio >50%; else VALID.

WITH base AS (
 SELECT e.*, md5(coalesce(cast(worker_id as varchar),'_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_')||'-'||coalesce(source_relation,'_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_')||'-'||coalesce(position_id,'_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_')||'-'||coalesce(cast(position_start_date as varchar),'_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_')) employee_id
 FROM intermediate.int_workday__worker_employee_enhanced e
), career AS (
 SELECT worker_id,source_relation,position_id,max(total_positions_held) total_positions_held,max(total_promotions) total_promotions,
 max(total_demotions) total_demotions,max(lateral_moves) lateral_moves,max(fast_promotions) fast_promotions,max(management_positions_held) management_positions_held,
 max(highest_management_level_reached) highest_management_level_reached,
 mode() within group(order by career_stability_category) career_stability_category,
 mode() within group(order by career_growth_pace) career_growth_pace,avg(career_development_score) career_development_score,
 mode() within group(order by career_phase) career_phase
 FROM intermediate.int_workday__career_progression GROUP BY worker_id,source_relation,position_id
), org AS (
 SELECT w.worker_id,w.source_relation,o.organization_id,o.organization_name,o.organization_type,o.organization_sub_type,
 o.current_employee_count,o.organization_health_score,o.annual_turnover_rate,o.management_ratio,o.performance_category,o.organization_size_category
 FROM staging.stg_workday__worker_position_organization w
 LEFT JOIN intermediate.int_workday__organization_metrics o ON w.organization_id=o.organization_id AND w.source_relation=o.source_relation
 WHERE w.effective_end IS NULL
), comp AS (
 SELECT p.position_id,p.source_relation,jp.compensation_grade_id,jp.is_work_shift_required,jp.is_union_eligible
 FROM staging.stg_workday__position_job_profile p
 LEFT JOIN staging.stg_workday__job_profile jp ON p.job_profile_id=jp.job_profile_id AND p.source_relation=jp.source_relation
), enriched AS (
 SELECT b.*,l.retained_30_days,l.retained_90_days,l.retained_1_year,l.retained_3_years,l.churn_risk_category,l.employee_maturity_segment,l.departure_category,l.tenure_years,
 l.hire_quarter_cohort,l.hire_year_cohort,l.retention_stability_score,l.hire_month,l.hire_season,
 c.total_positions_held,c.total_promotions,c.total_demotions,c.lateral_moves,c.fast_promotions,c.management_positions_held,c.highest_management_level_reached,c.career_stability_category,c.career_growth_pace,c.career_development_score,c.career_phase,
 o.organization_id,o.organization_name,o.organization_type,o.organization_sub_type,o.current_employee_count,o.organization_health_score,o.annual_turnover_rate,o.management_ratio,o.performance_category,o.organization_size_category,
 comp.compensation_grade_id,comp.is_work_shift_required,comp.is_union_eligible
 FROM base b LEFT JOIN intermediate.int_workday__employee_lifecycle l USING(worker_id,source_relation)
 LEFT JOIN career c ON b.worker_id=c.worker_id AND b.source_relation=c.source_relation AND b.position_id=c.position_id
 LEFT JOIN org o ON b.worker_id=o.worker_id AND b.source_relation=o.source_relation
 LEFT JOIN comp ON b.position_id=comp.position_id AND b.source_relation=comp.source_relation
), calc AS (
 SELECT *, CASE WHEN date_of_birth IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE date_diff('year',date_of_birth,current_date)-CASE WHEN strftime(current_date,'%m-%d')<strftime(date_of_birth,'%m-%d') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END END::BIGINT age,
 CASE WHEN days_as_worker<365 THEN '< 1 year' WHEN days_as_worker<730 THEN '1-2 years' WHEN days_as_worker<1825 THEN '2-5 years' WHEN days_as_worker<3650 THEN '5-10 years' ELSE '10+ years' END tenure_group,
 CASE WHEN regexp_extract(coalesce(compensation_grade_id,''),'([0-9]+)',1)='' THEN 'Ungraded' WHEN try_cast(regexp_extract(compensation_grade_id,'([0-9]+)',1) AS INTEGER)<=5 THEN 'Entry Level' WHEN try_cast(regexp_extract(compensation_grade_id,'([0-9]+)',1) AS INTEGER)<=10 THEN 'Mid Level' WHEN try_cast(regexp_extract(compensation_grade_id,'([0-9]+)',1) AS INTEGER)<=15 THEN 'Senior Level' ELSE 'Executive Level' END compensation_tier,
 (CASE WHEN coalesce(is_work_shift_required,FALSE) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END + CASE WHEN coalesce(is_union_eligible,FALSE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN default_weekly_hours<=40 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::INTEGER work_conditions_score
 FROM enriched
), finalized AS (
 SELECT *,round(coalesce(retention_stability_score,0)*.3+coalesce(career_development_score,0)*.4+coalesce(organization_health_score,0)*.2+work_conditions_score*10*.1,2)::DOUBLE overall_employee_score,
 CASE WHEN is_employed=FALSE THEN 'Former Employee' WHEN churn_risk_category='High Risk' THEN 'High Risk' WHEN churn_risk_category='Medium Risk' AND coalesce(career_development_score,0)<40 THEN 'Medium-High Risk' WHEN churn_risk_category='Medium Risk' THEN 'Medium Risk' WHEN churn_risk_category='Low Risk' AND coalesce(annual_turnover_rate,0)>20 THEN 'Medium-Low Risk' ELSE 'Low Risk' END employee_risk_level,
 CASE WHEN is_employed=FALSE THEN 'Former Employee' WHEN career_development_score>=80 AND retention_stability_score>=80 THEN 'High Value - High Retention' WHEN career_development_score>=80 THEN 'High Value - Flight Risk' WHEN retention_stability_score>=80 THEN 'Stable - Development Needed' WHEN career_development_score>=60 THEN 'Moderate Value' ELSE 'Development Required' END employee_value_segment
 FROM calc
)
SELECT employee_id,worker_id,source_relation,position_id,position_start_date,worker_history_id,event_type,is_employed,hire_date,departure_date,days_as_worker,first_name,last_name,full_name,date_of_birth,marital_status,city_of_birth,country_of_birth,email_address,ethnicity_codes,is_military_service,military_status,business_title,employee_type,default_weekly_hours,position_end_date,days_in_position,
 is_employed_one_year,is_employed_five_years,is_employed_ten_years,is_current_employee_one_year,is_current_employee_five_years,is_current_employee_ten_years,age,tenure_group,
 coalesce(retained_30_days,0)::INTEGER retained_30_days,coalesce(retained_90_days,0)::INTEGER retained_90_days,coalesce(retained_1_year,0)::INTEGER retained_1_year,coalesce(retained_3_years,0)::INTEGER retained_3_years,
 coalesce(churn_risk_category,'Unknown') churn_risk_category,coalesce(employee_maturity_segment,'Unknown') employee_maturity_segment,coalesce(departure_category,'Active Employee') departure_category,coalesce(tenure_years,0)::DOUBLE tenure_years,
 coalesce(hire_quarter_cohort,'Unknown') hire_quarter_cohort,coalesce(hire_year_cohort,year(hire_date))::BIGINT hire_year_cohort,coalesce(retention_stability_score,0)::INTEGER retention_stability_score,coalesce(hire_month,month(hire_date))::BIGINT hire_month,coalesce(hire_season,'Unknown') hire_season,
 coalesce(total_positions_held,1)::BIGINT total_positions_held,coalesce(total_promotions,0)::BIGINT total_promotions,coalesce(total_demotions,0)::BIGINT total_demotions,coalesce(lateral_moves,0)::BIGINT lateral_moves,coalesce(fast_promotions,0)::BIGINT fast_promotions,coalesce(management_positions_held,0)::BIGINT management_positions_held,coalesce(highest_management_level_reached,1)::INTEGER highest_management_level_reached,
 coalesce(career_stability_category,'Unknown') career_stability_category,coalesce(career_growth_pace,'Stable Career') career_growth_pace,coalesce(career_development_score,0)::DOUBLE career_development_score,coalesce(career_phase,'Unknown') career_phase,
 coalesce(organization_id,'Unknown') organization_id,coalesce(organization_name,'Unknown') organization_name,coalesce(organization_type,'Unknown') organization_type,coalesce(organization_sub_type,'Unknown') organization_sub_type,coalesce(current_employee_count,0)::BIGINT dept_size,coalesce(organization_health_score,0)::INTEGER dept_health_score,coalesce(annual_turnover_rate,0)::DOUBLE dept_turnover_rate,coalesce(management_ratio,0)::DOUBLE dept_management_ratio,coalesce(performance_category,'Unknown') dept_performance_category,coalesce(organization_size_category,'Unknown') dept_size_category,
 coalesce(compensation_grade_id,'Ungraded') compensation_grade_id,compensation_tier,coalesce(is_work_shift_required,FALSE) is_work_shift_required,coalesce(is_union_eligible,FALSE) is_union_eligible,work_conditions_score,overall_employee_score,employee_risk_level,employee_value_segment,
 CASE WHEN age<16 OR age>80 THEN 'ERROR: Invalid age' WHEN hire_date>CURRENT_DATE THEN 'ERROR: Future hire date' WHEN departure_date<hire_date THEN 'ERROR: Departure before hire' WHEN days_as_worker<0 THEN 'ERROR: Negative tenure' WHEN overall_employee_score<0 OR overall_employee_score>100 THEN 'ERROR: Score out of range' ELSE 'VALID' END comprehensive_data_quality_flag,
 current_timestamp::TIMESTAMPTZ analysis_timestamp
FROM finalized

blocks.original_text:
- name: workday__employee_overview
      description: 360-degree employee overview combining worker, lifecycle, career, organization, and compensation context with derived scores, risk/value segments, data-quality flag, and analysis timestamp
      grain: One row per (worker_id, source_relation, position_id, position_start_date)
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_workday__worker_employee_enhanced
      - intermediate.int_workday__employee_lifecycle
      - intermediate.int_workday__career_progression
      - intermediate.int_workday__organization_metrics
      - staging.stg_workday__worker_position_organization
      - staging.stg_workday__position_job_profile
      - staging.stg_workday__job_profile
      business_logic: '- Build employee_base_enhanced from intermediate.int_workday__worker_employee_enhanced (ebe): - employee_id is an MD5 of "<worker_id>-<source_relation>-<position_id>-<position_start_date>" using "-" as delimiter and replacing NULL components with "_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_". - Retain all ebe columns for downstream logic. - Lifecycle metrics (elm) from intermediate.int_workday__employee_lifecycle: select retention indicators, churn risk, maturity segment, departure category, tenure_years, hire cohorts (quarter, year, month, season), retention_stability_score; lifecycle data quality is selected but not used later. - Career metrics (cdc) from intermediate.int_workday__career_progression: - Group by worker_id, source_relation, position_id. - Numeric totals take the largest recorded value in the group; career_development_score is the mean. - Categorical fields (career_stability_category, career_growth_pace, career_phase) choose the most frequent value; when tied, pick the alphabetically earliest. - Also derive the most frequent data_quality_flag (unused downstream). - Organization context (oc): - Join worker_position_organization to organization_metrics on organization_id and source_relation; keep only current relationships (effective_end is NULL). - Retain organization details and department KPIs (size, health, turnover, management ratio, performance, size category). - Join to ebe on worker_id and source_relation so the current organization applies across that worker’s positions. - Compensation/benefits (cb): - Join ebe to position_job_profile by position_id and source_relation, then to job_profile by job_profile_id and source_relation. - Read compensation_grade_id and classify compensation_tier by the first sequence of digits found in the grade id converted to a number: missing/non-numeric → ''Ungraded''; ≤5 → ''Entry Level''; ≤10 → ''Mid Level''; ≤15 → ''Senior Level''; >15 → ''Executive Level''. - work_conditions_score is the sum of three components (0–3): shift required → 0 else 1; union eligible → 1 else 0; default_weekly_hours ≤40 → 1 else 0; NULLs follow the else branch. - Build the comprehensive profile by left joining ebe to elm (worker_id, source_relation), cdc (worker_id, source_relation, position_id), oc (worker_id, source_relation), and cb (worker_id, source_relation, position_id). Compute: - age from date_of_birth relative to current_date with birthday adjustment; NULL when date_of_birth is NULL. - tenure_group from days_as_worker: <365 ''< 1 year''; <730 ''1-2 years''; <1825 ''2-5 years''; <3650 ''5-10 years''; else ''10+ years'' (NULL falls to else). - Default NULLs using these rules: - Lifecycle: retained_30_days/90_days/1_year/3_years → 0; churn_risk_category → ''Unknown''; employee_maturity_segment → ''Unknown''; specification.name: workday__employee_overview
specification.description: 360-degree employee overview combining worker, lifecycle, career, organization, and compensation context with derived scores, risk/value segments, data-quality flag, and analysis timestamp
specification.grain: One row per (worker_id, source_relation, position_id, position_start_date)
specification.business_logic: - Build employee_base_enhanced from intermediate.int_workday__worker_employee_enhanced (ebe): - employee_id is an MD5 of "<worker_id>-<source_relation>-<position_id>-<position_start_date>" using "-" as delimiter and replacing NULL components with "_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_". - Retain all ebe columns for downstream logic. - Lifecycle metrics (elm) from intermediate.int_workday__employee_lifecycle: select retention indicators, churn risk, maturity segment, departure category, tenure_years, hire cohorts (quarter, year, month, season), retention_stability_score; lifecycle data quality is selected but not used later. - Career metrics (cdc) from intermediate.int_workday__career_progression: - Group by worker_id, source_relation, position_id. - Numeric totals take the largest recorded value in the group; career_development_score is the mean. - Categorical fields (career_stability_category, career_growth_pace, career_phase) choose the most frequent value; when tied, pick the alphabetically earliest. - Also derive the most frequent data_quality_flag (unused downstream). - Organization context (oc): - Join worker_position_organization to organization_metrics on organization_id and source_relation; keep only current relationships (effective_end is NULL). - Retain organization details and department KPIs (size, health, turnover, management ratio, performance, size category). - Join to ebe on worker_id and source_relation so the current organization applies across that worker’s positions. - Compensation/benefits (cb): - Join ebe to position_job_profile by position_id and source_relation, then to job_profile by job_profile_id and source_relation. - Read compensation_grade_id and classify compensation_tier by the first sequence of digits found in the grade id converted to a number: missing/non-numeric → 'Ungraded'; ≤5 → 'Entry Level'; ≤10 → 'Mid Level'; ≤15 → 'Senior Level'; >15 → 'Executive Level'. - work_conditions_score is the sum of three components (0–3): shift required → 0 else 1; union eligible → 1 else 0; default_weekly_hours ≤40 → 1 else 0; NULLs follow the else branch. - Build the comprehensive profile by left joining ebe to elm (worker_id, source_relation), cdc (worker_id, source_relation, position_id), oc (worker_id, source_relation), and cb (worker_id, source_relation, position_id). Compute: - age from date_of_birth relative to current_date with birthday adjustment; NULL when date_of_birth is NULL. - tenure_group from days_as_worker: <365 '< 1 year'; <730 '1-2 years'; <1825 '2-5 years'; <3650 '5-10 years'; else '10+ years' (NULL falls to else). - Default NULLs using these rules: - Lifecycle: retained_30_days/90_days/1_year/3_years → 0; churn_risk_category → 'Unknown'; employee_maturity_segment → 'Unknown'; departure_category → 'Active Employee'; tenure_years → 0; hire_quarter_cohort → 'Unknown'; hire_year_cohort → calendar year of hire_date; retention_stability_score → 0; hire_month → month number of hire_date; hire_season → 'Unknown'. - Career: total_positions_held → 1; total_promotions/demotions/lateral_moves/fast_promotions/management_positions_held → 0; highest_management_level_reached → 1; career_stability_category → 'Unknown'; career_growth_pace → 'Stable Career'; career_development_score → 0; career_phase → 'Unknown'. - Organization: organization_id/name/type/sub_type → 'Unknown'; dept_size → 0; dept_health_score → 0; dept_turnover_rate → 0; dept_management_ratio → 0; dept_performance_category → 'Unknown'; dept_size_category → 'Unknown'. - Compensation: compensation_grade_id → 'Ungraded'; compensation_tier → 'Ungraded'; is_work_shift_required/is_union_eligible → false; work_conditions_score → 0. - overall_employee_score = round(retention_stability_score*0.3 + career_development_score*0.4 + dept_health_score*0.2 + work_conditions_score*10*0.1, to 2 decimals); may fall outside 0–100. - employee_risk_level: - not employed → 'Former Employee' - else: 'High Risk' if churn risk is 'High Risk'; 'Medium-High Risk' if churn risk is 'Medium Risk' and career_development_score < 40; 'Medium Risk' if churn risk is 'Medium Risk'; 'Medium-Low Risk' if churn risk is 'Low Risk' and dept_turnover_rate > 20; else 'Low Risk'. - employee_value_segment: - not employed → 'Former Employee' - else: career_development_score ≥80 and retention_stability_score ≥80 → 'High Value - High Retention'; career_development_score ≥80 and retention_stability_score <80 → 'High Value - Flight Risk'; career_development_score <80 and retention_stability_score ≥80 → 'Stable - Development Needed'; career_development_score ≥60 → 'Moderate Value'; else 'Development Required'. - comprehensive_data_quality_flag (first match wins): invalid age (<16 or >80); future hire date; departure before hire; negative tenure; score out of range (<0 or >100); else 'VALID'. - analysis_timestamp is the current timestamp at execution.

columns.description: Current organization_id from join of worker_position_organization→organization_metrics; NULL → 'Unknown'

columns.name: organization_name
columns.description: Current organization name; NULL → 'Unknown'

columns.name: organization_type
columns.description: Organization type; NULL → 'Unknown'

columns.name: organization_sub_type
columns.description: Organization sub-type; NULL → 'Unknown'

columns.name: dept_size
columns.description: Department size (current_employee_count) with NULL → 0

columns.name: dept_health_score
columns.description: Organization health score 0–100 with NULL → 0

columns.name: dept_turnover_rate
columns.description: Annual turnover rate with NULL → 0; used in risk level ('Low Risk' + >20 → 'Medium-Low Risk')

columns.name: dept_management_ratio
columns.description: Management ratio with NULL → 0

columns.name: dept_performance_category
columns.description: Organization performance category with NULL → 'Unknown'

columns.name: dept_size_category
columns.description: Organization size category with NULL → 'Unknown'

columns.name: compensation_grade_id
columns.description: Job profile compensation grade id; NULL → 'Ungraded'

columns.name: compensation_tier
columns.description: Tier from the first digit sequence in compensation_grade_id: ≤5 'Entry Level', ≤10 'Mid Level', ≤15 'Senior Level', >15 'Executive Level', else 'Ungraded'

columns.name: is_work_shift_required
columns.description: Job profile flag; final output NULL → false; contributes 0 if true else 1 to work_conditions_score

columns.name: is_union_eligible
columns.description: Job profile flag; final output NULL → false; contributes 1 if true else 0 to work_conditions_score

columns.name: work_conditions_score
columns.description: Sum of three components (range 0–3): not shift required=1, union eligible=1, default_weekly_hours≤40=1; computed with NULLs treated as false/0 and final NULL → 0

columns.name: overall_employee_score
columns.description: Rounded to 2 decimals: retention_stability_score*0.3 + career_development_score*0.4 + dept_health_score*0.2 + work_conditions_score*10*0.1; not force-bounded to [0,100]

columns.name: employee_risk_level
columns.description: Risk level: not employed 'Former Employee'; else High/Medium/Medium-High/Medium-Low/Low per churn risk, career_development_score<40, and dept_turnover_rate>20

columns.name: employee_value_segment
columns.description: Value segment: not employed 'Former Employee'; else rules on career_development_score and retention_stability_score

columns.name: comprehensive_data_quality_flag
columns.description: First-match checks: invalid age, future hire date, departure before hire, negative tenure, score out of range; else 'VALID'

columns.name: analysis_timestamp
columns.description: Current timestamp at query execution time for the record build

WITH family AS (
 SELECT jfjp.job_profile_id,jf.source_relation,count(DISTINCT jf.job_family_id) associated_job_families_count,count(DISTINCT jfg.job_family_group_id) associated_job_family_groups_count,
 string_agg(DISTINCT jf.job_family_code,', ') FILTER(WHERE jf.job_family_code IS NOT NULL) job_family_codes,string_agg(DISTINCT jf.job_family_name,', ') FILTER(WHERE jf.job_family_name IS NOT NULL) job_family_names,
 string_agg(DISTINCT jfg.job_family_group_code,', ') FILTER(WHERE jfg.job_family_group_code IS NOT NULL) job_family_group_codes,string_agg(DISTINCT jfg.job_family_group_name,', ') FILTER(WHERE jfg.job_family_group_name IS NOT NULL) job_family_group_names
 FROM staging.stg_workday__job_family_job_profile jfjp LEFT JOIN staging.stg_workday__job_family jf ON jfjp.job_family_id=jf.job_family_id AND jfjp.source_relation=jf.source_relation
 LEFT JOIN staging.stg_workday__job_family_job_family_group jfjg ON jf.job_family_id=jfjg.job_family_id AND jf.source_relation=jfjg.source_relation
 LEFT JOIN staging.stg_workday__job_family_group jfg ON jfjg.job_family_group_id=jfg.job_family_group_id AND jfjg.source_relation=jfg.source_relation
 GROUP BY jfjp.job_profile_id,jf.source_relation
), positions AS (
 SELECT pjp.job_profile_id,pjp.source_relation,count(DISTINCT p.position_id) total_positions_count,count(DISTINCT p.position_id) FILTER(WHERE wpo.effective_end IS NULL) active_positions_count,
 count(DISTINCT p.position_id) FILTER(WHERE wpo.effective_end IS NOT NULL) inactive_positions_count,count(DISTINCT wpo.worker_id) FILTER(WHERE wpo.effective_end IS NULL) current_employees_count,count(DISTINCT wpo.worker_id) total_employees_ever_count,
 avg(p.default_weekly_hours) avg_weekly_hours,min(p.default_weekly_hours) min_weekly_hours,max(p.default_weekly_hours) max_weekly_hours,
 count(DISTINCT wpo.worker_id) FILTER(WHERE wpo.effective_end IS NULL AND p.employee_type='Regular') regular_employees_count,count(DISTINCT wpo.worker_id) FILTER(WHERE wpo.effective_end IS NULL AND p.employee_type='Contingent') contingent_employees_count,count(DISTINCT wpo.worker_id) FILTER(WHERE wpo.effective_end IS NULL AND p.employee_type='Intern') intern_employees_count,
 count(DISTINCT wpo.organization_id) organizations_using_job_count
 FROM staging.stg_workday__position_job_profile pjp LEFT JOIN staging.stg_workday__position p ON pjp.position_id=p.position_id AND pjp.source_relation=p.source_relation
 LEFT JOIN staging.stg_workday__worker_position_organization wpo ON p.position_id=wpo.position_id AND p.source_relation=wpo.source_relation GROUP BY pjp.job_profile_id,pjp.source_relation
), ep AS (
 SELECT pjp.job_profile_id,pjp.source_relation,
 avg(e.career_development_score) FILTER(WHERE e.is_employed) avg_career_development_score,count(DISTINCT e.worker_id) FILTER(WHERE e.is_employed AND e.total_promotions>=2) high_achievers_count,count(DISTINCT e.worker_id) FILTER(WHERE e.is_employed AND e.fast_promotions>0) fast_track_employees_count,
 count(DISTINCT e.worker_id) FILTER(WHERE e.churn_risk_category='High Risk') high_risk_employees_count,count(DISTINCT e.worker_id) FILTER(WHERE e.churn_risk_category='Medium Risk') medium_risk_employees_count,count(DISTINCT e.worker_id) FILTER(WHERE e.churn_risk_category IN('Low Risk','Stable')) stable_employees_count,
 count(DISTINCT e.worker_id) FILTER(WHERE e.is_employed AND e.employee_maturity_segment LIKE '%New Hire%') new_hires_count,count(DISTINCT e.worker_id) FILTER(WHERE e.is_employed AND e.employee_maturity_segment LIKE '%Junior%') junior_employees_count,count(DISTINCT e.worker_id) FILTER(WHERE e.is_employed AND e.employee_maturity_segment LIKE '%Experienced%') experienced_employees_count,count(DISTINCT e.worker_id) FILTER(WHERE e.is_employed AND e.employee_maturity_segment LIKE '%Senior%') senior_employees_count,count(DISTINCT e.worker_id) FILTER(WHERE e.is_employed AND e.employee_maturity_segment LIKE '%Veteran%') veteran_employees_count,
 avg(e.age) FILTER(WHERE e.is_employed) avg_employee_age,count(DISTINCT e.worker_id) FILTER(WHERE e.is_employed AND e.age BETWEEN 18 AND 30) young_professionals_count,count(DISTINCT e.worker_id) FILTER(WHERE e.is_employed AND e.age BETWEEN 31 AND 45) mid_career_professionals_count,count(DISTINCT e.worker_id) FILTER(WHERE e.is_employed AND e.age BETWEEN 46 AND 60) senior_professionals_count,
 count(DISTINCT e.worker_id) FILTER(WHERE e.employee_value_segment='High Value - High Retention') high_value_retained_count,count(DISTINCT e.worker_id) FILTER(WHERE e.employee_value_segment='High Value - Flight Risk') high_value_flight_risk_count,
 count(DISTINCT e.worker_id) FILTER(WHERE e.is_employed AND e.compensation_tier='Entry Level') entry_level_employees_count,count(DISTINCT e.worker_id) FILTER(WHERE e.is_employed AND e.compensation_tier='Mid Level') mid_level_employees_count,count(DISTINCT e.worker_id) FILTER(WHERE e.is_employed AND e.compensation_tier='Senior Level') senior_level_employees_count,count(DISTINCT e.worker_id) FILTER(WHERE e.is_employed AND e.compensation_tier='Executive Level') executive_level_employees_count
 FROM staging.stg_workday__position_job_profile pjp LEFT JOIN mart.workday__employee_overview e ON pjp.position_id=e.position_id AND pjp.source_relation=e.source_relation GROUP BY pjp.job_profile_id,pjp.source_relation
)
SELECT jp.job_profile_id,jp.source_relation,jp.job_profile_code,jp.job_profile_title job_title,jp.job_profile_summary job_summary,jp.management_level,jp.compensation_grade_id,jp.is_work_shift_required,jp.is_union_eligible,
coalesce(f.job_family_codes,'Unknown') job_family_codes,coalesce(f.job_family_names,'Unknown') job_family_names,coalesce(f.job_family_group_codes,'Unknown') job_family_group_codes,coalesce(f.job_family_group_names,'Unknown') job_family_group_names,coalesce(f.associated_job_families_count,0)::BIGINT associated_job_families_count,coalesce(f.associated_job_family_groups_count,0)::BIGINT associated_job_family_groups_count,
coalesce(p.total_positions_count,0)::BIGINT total_positions_count,coalesce(p.active_positions_count,0)::BIGINT active_positions_count,coalesce(p.inactive_positions_count,0)::BIGINT inactive_positions_count,coalesce(p.current_employees_count,0)::BIGINT current_employees_count,coalesce(p.total_employees_ever_count,0)::BIGINT total_employees_ever_count,
coalesce(p.avg_weekly_hours,40)::DOUBLE avg_weekly_hours,coalesce(p.min_weekly_hours,0)::BIGINT min_weekly_hours,coalesce(p.max_weekly_hours,0)::BIGINT max_weekly_hours,coalesce(p.regular_employees_count,0)::BIGINT regular_employees_count,coalesce(p.contingent_employees_count,0)::BIGINT contingent_employees_count,coalesce(p.intern_employees_count,0)::BIGINT intern_employees_count,coalesce(p.organizations_using_job_count,0)::BIGINT organizations_using_job_count,'Unknown'::VARCHAR primary_organization_id,
coalesce(e.avg_career_development_score,0)::DOUBLE avg_career_development_score,coalesce(e.high_achievers_count,0)::BIGINT high_achievers_count,coalesce(e.fast_track_employees_count,0)::BIGINT fast_track_employees_count,coalesce(e.high_risk_employees_count,0)::BIGINT high_risk_employees_count,coalesce(e.medium_risk_employees_count,0)::BIGINT medium_risk_employees_count,coalesce(e.stable_employees_count,0)::BIGINT stable_employees_count,coalesce(e.new_hires_count,0)::BIGINT new_hires_count,coalesce(e.junior_employees_count,0)::BIGINT junior_employees_count,coalesce(e.experienced_employees_count,0)::BIGINT experienced_employees_count,coalesce(e.senior_employees_count,0)::BIGINT senior_employees_count,coalesce(e.veteran_employees_count,0)::BIGINT veteran_employees_count,
coalesce(round(e.avg_employee_age,1),0)::DOUBLE avg_employee_age,coalesce(e.young_professionals_count,0)::BIGINT young_professionals_count,coalesce(e.mid_career_professionals_count,0)::BIGINT mid_career_professionals_count,coalesce(e.senior_professionals_count,0)::BIGINT senior_professionals_count,coalesce(e.high_value_retained_count,0)::BIGINT high_value_retained_count,coalesce(e.high_value_flight_risk_count,0)::BIGINT high_value_flight_risk_count,coalesce(e.entry_level_employees_count,0)::BIGINT entry_level_employees_count,coalesce(e.mid_level_employees_count,0)::BIGINT mid_level_employees_count,coalesce(e.senior_level_employees_count,0)::BIGINT senior_level_employees_count,coalesce(e.executive_level_employees_count,0)::BIGINT executive_level_employees_count,
CASE WHEN coalesce(p.total_positions_count,0)=0 THEN 'No Positions' WHEN p.total_positions_count<=2 THEN 'Very Rare' WHEN p.total_positions_count<=5 THEN 'Rare' WHEN p.total_positions_count<=15 THEN 'Uncommon' WHEN p.total_positions_count<=50 THEN 'Common' ELSE 'Very Common' END job_rarity_level,
CASE WHEN coalesce(p.current_employees_count,0)=0 THEN 'No Current Employees' WHEN p.current_employees_count*1.0/NULLIF(p.total_positions_count,0)>=.9 THEN 'High' WHEN p.current_employees_count*1.0/NULLIF(p.total_positions_count,0)>=.7 THEN 'Moderate' WHEN p.current_employees_count*1.0/NULLIF(p.total_positions_count,0)>=.5 THEN 'Low' ELSE 'Very Low' END talent_competition_level,
CASE WHEN coalesce(e.avg_career_development_score,0)>=80 THEN 'Highly Developed Role' WHEN e.avg_career_development_score>=60 THEN 'Well Developed Role' WHEN e.avg_career_development_score>=40 THEN 'Moderately Developed Role' WHEN e.avg_career_development_score>=20 THEN 'Developing Role' ELSE 'New/Emerging Role' END job_maturity_level,
CASE WHEN coalesce(p.current_employees_count,0)=0 THEN 'No Data' WHEN e.high_risk_employees_count*1.0/p.current_employees_count>=.3 THEN 'High' WHEN e.high_risk_employees_count*1.0/p.current_employees_count>=.2 THEN 'Moderate' WHEN e.high_risk_employees_count*1.0/p.current_employees_count>=.1 THEN 'Low' ELSE 'Excellent' END retention_difficulty_level,
round(coalesce(e.high_achievers_count,0)*100.0/NULLIF(p.current_employees_count,0),2)::FLOAT high_performer_percentage,round(coalesce(e.fast_track_employees_count,0)*100.0/NULLIF(p.current_employees_count,0),2)::FLOAT career_growth_potential_percentage,
round((CASE WHEN coalesce(p.current_employees_count,0)>0 THEN 20 ELSE 0 END+least(25,coalesce(e.avg_career_development_score,0)*.357)+least(25,coalesce(e.high_achievers_count,0)*100.0/NULLIF(p.current_employees_count,0)*.833)+CASE WHEN coalesce(e.high_risk_employees_count,0)=0 THEN 15 WHEN e.high_risk_employees_count*1.0/NULLIF(p.current_employees_count,0)<=.1 THEN 10 ELSE 5 END+least(15,coalesce(p.organizations_using_job_count,0)*5)),2)::DOUBLE job_health_score,
CASE WHEN coalesce(p.current_employees_count,0)=0 THEN 'Inactive Job' WHEN e.high_achievers_count*100.0/NULLIF(p.current_employees_count,0)>=40 AND e.avg_career_development_score>=80 THEN 'Strategic High-Value Role' WHEN e.high_achievers_count*100.0/NULLIF(p.current_employees_count,0)>=25 AND e.avg_career_development_score>=60 THEN 'High-Value Role' WHEN e.high_achievers_count*100.0/NULLIF(p.current_employees_count,0)>=15 AND e.avg_career_development_score>=40 THEN 'Standard Value Role' WHEN e.high_achievers_count*100.0/NULLIF(p.current_employees_count,0)>=10 THEN 'Developing Role' ELSE 'Entry-Level Role' END job_value_tier,
CASE WHEN coalesce(p.current_employees_count,0)=0 THEN 'Review Job Necessity' WHEN e.high_risk_employees_count*1.0/NULLIF(p.current_employees_count,0)>.3 THEN 'Focus on Retention' WHEN coalesce(e.high_achievers_count,0)*100.0/NULLIF(p.current_employees_count,0)<15 THEN 'Enhance Performance Management' WHEN coalesce(e.avg_career_development_score,0)<50 THEN 'Improve Career Development' WHEN coalesce(p.organizations_using_job_count,0)=1 THEN 'Consider Cross-Organizational Expansion' ELSE 'Maintain Excellence' END talent_management_recommendation,
CASE WHEN jp.job_profile_title IS NULL OR trim(jp.job_profile_title)='' THEN 'ERROR: Missing job title' WHEN p.total_positions_count<0 THEN 'ERROR: Negative position count' WHEN p.current_employees_count>p.total_positions_count THEN 'WARNING: More employees than positions' WHEN p.avg_weekly_hours>80 THEN 'WARNING: Excessive working hours' ELSE 'VALID' END data_quality_flag,current_timestamp::TIMESTAMPTZ analysis_timestamp
FROM staging.stg_workday__job_profile jp LEFT JOIN family f USING(job_profile_id,source_relation) LEFT JOIN positions p USING(job_profile_id,source_relation) LEFT JOIN ep e USING(job_profile_id,source_relation)

CASE WHEN coalesce(p.total_positions_count,0)=0 THEN 'No Positions' WHEN p.total_positions_count<=2 THEN 'Very Rare' WHEN p.total_positions_count<=5 THEN 'Rare' WHEN p.total_positions_count<=15 THEN 'Uncommon' WHEN p.total_positions_count<=50 THEN 'Common' ELSE 'Very Common' END job_rarity_level,
CASE WHEN coalesce(p.current_employees_count,0)=0 THEN 'No Current Employees' WHEN p.current_employees_count*1.0/NULLIF(p.total_positions_count,0)>=.9 THEN 'High' WHEN p.current_employees_count*1.0/NULLIF(p.total_positions_count,0)>=.7 THEN 'Moderate' WHEN p.current_employees_count*1.0/NULLIF(p.total_positions_count,0)>=.5 THEN 'Low' ELSE 'Very Low' END talent_competition_level,

CASE WHEN coalesce(p.current_employees_count,0)=0 THEN 'Inactive Job' WHEN e.high_achievers_count*100.0/NULLIF(p.current_employees_count,0)>=40 AND e.avg_career_development_score>=80 THEN 'Strategic High-Value Role' WHEN e.high_achievers_count*100.0/NULLIF(p.current_employees_count,0)>=25 AND e.avg_career_development_score>=60 THEN 'High-Value Role' WHEN e.high_achievers_count*100.0/NULLIF(p.current_employees_count,0)>=15 AND e.avg_career_development_score>=40 THEN 'Standard Value Role' WHEN e.high_achievers_count*100.0/NULLIF(p.current_employees_count,0)>=10 THEN 'Developing Role' ELSE 'Entry-Level Role' END job_value_tier,

CASE WHEN jp.job_profile_title IS NULL OR trim(jp.job_profile_title)='' THEN 'ERROR: Missing job title' WHEN p.total_positions_count<0 THEN 'ERROR: Negative position count' WHEN p.current_employees_count>p.total_positions_count THEN 'WARNING: More employees than positions' WHEN p.avg_weekly_hours>80 THEN 'WARNING: Excessive working hours' ELSE 'VALID' END data_quality_flag,current_timestamp::TIMESTAMPTZ analysis_timestamp

blocks.original_text:
- name: workday__job_overview
      description: Job profile overview aggregated from Workday staging tables with usage, employee, career mobility, market value, and health metrics
      grain: One row per job_profile_id and source_relation
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_workday__job_profile
      - staging.stg_workday__job_family_job_profile
      - staging.stg_workday__job_family
      - staging.stg_workday__job_family_job_family_group
      - staging.stg_workday__job_family_group
      - staging.stg_workday__position_job_profile
      - staging.stg_workday__position
      - staging.stg_workday__worker_position_organization
      - mart.workday__employee_overview
      business_logic: 'Construct one row per job_profile_id and source_relation: - Base attributes: take all master job profile fields. - Job family hierarchy: - Link each profile to its job families and family groups through the provided relationships. - For each profile, collect distinct job family codes and names, and distinct family group codes and names; concatenate with ", "; exclude nulls; no enforced sort order. Also count distinct families and distinct family groups. - Position utilization: - Link positions to the profile, then link worker-position-organization assignments. - Positions: total is the number of distinct positions linked; active positions are those with at least one current assignment; inactive positions are those with at least one ended assignment (a position can appear in both if it has both current and ended assignments). - Employees: current is distinct workers on current assignments; ever is distinct workers on any assignment. - Weekly hours: compute average, minimum, and maximum of position default weekly hours (no rounding). - Employee types: for current assignments, count distinct workers by position employee_type (Regular, Contingent, Intern). - Organizations: count distinct organization IDs using the job; the primary organization is the most frequent ID, with ties resolved by the lowest ID when sorted ascending. - Career mobility and demographics (from employee overview joined via position-job profile): - Averages: career development score (for employed workers, rounded to 2 decimals) and age (for employed workers, rounded to 1 decimal). - High achievers: distinct employed workers with two or more promotions. - Fast track: distinct employed workers with any fast promotion. - Retention risk: distinct workers by churn risk category (High, Medium, and Low/Stable) without restricting to employed. - Maturity segments: distinct employed workers in segments matching New Hire, Junior, Experienced, Senior, Veteran. - Age bands: distinct employed workers aged 18–30, 31–45, and 46–60 (inclusive ranges). - Compensation tiers: distinct employed workers in Entry, Mid, Senior, Executive tiers. - Market value: - Job rarity: categorize by total positions (0 → No Positions; ≤2 → Very Rare; ≤5 → Rare; ≤15 → Uncommon; ≤50 → Common; >50 → Very Common). - Talent competition: if there are no current employees, label No Current Employees; otherwise compute current employees per position and assign High (≥0.9), Moderate (≥0.7), Low (≥0.5), or Very Low. - Job maturity: categorize by average career score (≥80 Highly Developed Role; ≥60 Well Developed Role; ≥40 Moderately Developed Role; ≥20 Developing Role; else New/Emerging Role). - Retention difficulty: if there are no current employees, label No Data; otherwise compute the share of high-risk workers among current and assign High (≥0.3), Moderate (≥0.2), Low (≥0.1), or Excellent. - Percentages: high performer percentage = 100 × (high achievers / current employees), and career growth potential percentage = 100 × (fast track / current employees); when there are no current employees, both are 0; round both to 2 decimals. - Defaults in the final output when values are missing: - Job family strings → "Unknown"; counts → 0. - Weekly hours: average → 40; minimum and maximum → 0. - Organization metrics: organizations_using_job_count → 0; primary_organization_id → "Unknown". - Career averages: avg_career_development_score → 0; avg_employee_age → 0. - Market labels: job_rarity_level, talent_competition_level, job_maturity_level, retention_difficulty_level → "Unknown". - Percentages: high_performer_percentage and career_growth_potential_percentage → 0. - Job health score (rounded to 2 decimals) is the sum of: - +20 if there are current employees, else +0. - Career development: +25 if average career score ≥70; otherwise average career score × 0.357. - High performers: +25 if high performer percentage ≥30; otherwise high performer percentage × 0.833. - Retention stability: +15 if there are no high-risk workers; +10 if the high-risk share among current employees is ≤10%; otherwise +5. - Organizational breadth: +15 if three or more organizations use the job; otherwise 5 points per organization. - Job value tier: - If there are no current employees → Inactive Job. - Else, evaluate in order: (1) high performer percentage ≥40 and average career score ≥80 → Strategic High-Value Role; (2) high performer percentage ≥25 and average career score ≥60 → High-Value Role; (3) high performer percentage ≥15 and average career score ≥40 → Standard Value Role; (4) high performer percentage ≥10 → Developing Role; else Entry-Level Role. - Talent management recommendation (evaluate in order): - No current employees → Review Job Necessity. - High-risk share among current employees >30% → Focus on Retention. - High performer percentage <15% → Enhance Performance Management. - Average career score <50 → Improve Career Development. - Exactly one organization uses the job → Consider Cross-Organizational Expansion. - Else → Maintain Excellence. - Data quality flag (evaluate in order): - Missing or blank job title → ERROR: Missing job title. - Negative total position count → ERROR: Negative position count. - Current employees exceed total positions → WARNING: More employees than positions. - Average weekly hours >80 → WARNING: Excessive working hours. - Else → VALID. - Row ordering in the final result: sort by current_employees_count descending, then high_performer_percentage descending, then job_title ascending.'
      columns:
      - name: job_profile_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Job profile identifier used as a grouping key; one row per job_profile_id+source_relation
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source system identifier paired with job_profile_id for joins and grouping
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: job_profile_code
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Workday job profile code from the master profile
      - name: job_title
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Job profile title from the master profile
      - name: job_summary
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Job profile summary from the master profile
      - name: management_level
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Management level associated with the job profile
      - name: compensation_grade_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Compensation grade identifier from the job profile
      - name: is_work_shift_required
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Indicates whether the job requires work shifts per the master profile
      - name: is_union_eligible
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Indicates whether the job is union eligible per the master profile
      - name: job_family_codes
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Distinct job family codes concatenated with ', '; nulls excluded; order not enforced; default 'Unknown'
      - name: job_family_names
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Distinct job family names concatenated with ', '; nulls excluded; order not enforced; default 'Unknown'
      - name: job_family_group_codes
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Distinct job family group codes concatenated with ', '; nulls excluded; order not enforced; default 'Unknown'
      - name: job_family_group_names
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Distinct job family group names concatenated with ', '; nulls excluded; order not enforced; default 'Unknown'
      - name: associated_job_families_count
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of distinct job families linked to the profile; default 0
      - name: associated_job_family_groups_count
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of distinct job family groups linked via families; default 0
      - name: total_positions_count
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct positions associated with the job profile; default 0
      - name: active_positions_count
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct positions with at least one current assignment; default 0
      - name: inactive_positions_count
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct positions with at least one ended assignment; default 0
      - name: current_employees_count
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct workers on current assignments for the job; default 0
      - name: total_employees_ever_count
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct workers ever assigned to positions for the job; default 0
      - name: avg_weekly_hours
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average of position default weekly hours (no rounding); default 40 when missing
      - name: min_weekly_hours
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Minimum position default weekly hours; default 0 when missing
      - name: max_weekly_hours
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Maximum position default weekly hours; default 0 when missing
      - name: regular_employees_count
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct current workers where position employee_type is 'Regular'; default 0
      - name: contingent_employees_count
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct current workers where position employee_type is 'Contingent'; default 0
      - name: intern_employees_count
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct current workers where position employee_type is 'Intern'; default 0
      - name: organizations_using_job_count
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct organization IDs using the job across assignments; default 0
      - name: primary_organization_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Most frequent organization_id with ties resolved by the lowest ID; default 'Unknown'
      - name: avg_career_development_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average career development score for employed workers rounded to 2 decimals; default 0
      - name: high_achievers_count

      - name: fast_track_employees_count

      - name: high_risk_employees_count

        description: Distinct workers labeled 'High Risk' for churn; default 0
      - name: medium_risk_employees_count
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct workers labeled 'Medium Risk' for churn; default 0
      - name: stable_employees_count
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct workers labeled 'Low Risk' or 'Stable' for churn; default 0
      - name: new_hires_count
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct employed workers in the 'New Hire' maturity segment; default 0
      - name: junior_employees_count
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct employed workers in the 'Junior' maturity segment; default 0
      - name: experienced_employees_count
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct employed workers in the 'Experienced' maturity segment; default 0
      - name: senior_employees_count

        description: Distinct employed workers in the 'Senior' maturity segment; default 0
      - name: veteran_employees_count

      - name: young_professionals_count

      - name: mid_career_professionals_count

      - name: senior_professionals_count

      - name: high_value_flight_risk_count

      - name: entry_level_employees_count

≤2 → Very Rare; ≤5 → Rare; ≤15 → Uncommon; ≤50 → Common; >50 → Very Common). - Talent competition: if there are no current employees, label No Current Employees; otherwise compute current employees per position and assign High (≥0.9), Moderate (≥0.7), Low (≥0.5), or Very Low. - Job maturity: categorize by average career score (≥80 Highly Developed Role; ≥60 Well Developed Role; ≥40 Moderately Developed Role; ≥20 Developing Role; else New/Emerging Role). - Retention difficulty: if there are no current employees, label No Data; otherwise compute the share of high-risk workers among current and assign High (≥0.3), Moderate (≥0.2), Low (≥0.1), or Excellent. - Percentages: high performer percentage = 100 × (high achievers / current employees), and career growth potential percentage = 100 × (fast track / current employees); when there are no current employees, both are 0; round both to 2 decimals. - Defaults in the final output when values are missing: - Job family strings → "Unknown"; counts → 0. - Weekly hours: average → 40; minimum and maximum → 0. - Organization metrics: organizations_using_job_count → 0; primary_organization_id → "Unknown". - Career averages: avg_career_development_score → 0; avg_employee_age → 0. - Market labels: job_rarity_level, talent_competition_level, job_maturity_level, retention_difficulty_level → "Unknown". - Percentages: high_performer_percentage and career_growth_potential_percentage → 0. - Job health score (rounded to 2 decimals) is the sum of: - +20 if there are current employees, else +0. - Career development: +25 if average career score ≥70; otherwise average career score × 0.357. - High performers: +25 if high performer percentage ≥30; otherwise high performer percentage × 0.833. - Retention stability: +15 if there are no high-risk workers; +10 if the high-risk share among current employees is ≤10%; otherwise +5. - Organizational breadth: +15 if three or more organizations use the job; otherwise 5 points per organization. - Job value tier: - If there are no current employees → Inactive Job. - Else, evaluate in order: (1) high performer percentage ≥40 and average career score ≥80 → Strategic High-Value Role; (2) high performer percentage ≥25 and average career score ≥60 → High-Value Role; (3) high performer percentage ≥15 and average career score ≥40 → Standard Value Role; (4) high performer percentage ≥10 → Developing Role; else Entry-Level Role. - Talent management recommendation (evaluate in order): - No current employees → Review Job Necessity. - High-risk share among current employees >30% → Focus on Retention. - High performer percentage <15% → Enhance Performance Management. - Average career score <50 → Improve Career Development. - Exactly one organization uses the job → Consider Cross-Organizational Expansion. - Else → Maintain Excellence. - Data quality flag (evaluate in order): - Missing or blank job title → ERROR: Missing job title. - Negative total position count → ERROR: Negative position count. - Current employees exceed total positions → WARNING: More employees than positions. - Average weekly hours >80 → WARNING: Excessive working hours. - Else → VALID. - Row ordering in the final result: sort by current_employees_count descending, then high_performer_percentage descending, then job_title ascending.
