WITH active_org AS (SELECT * FROM staging.stg_workday__organization WHERE is_inactive=FALSE), rel AS (
 SELECT worker_id,organization_id,source_relation,position_id,effective_start,effective_end,
 date_diff('day',effective_start,coalesce(effective_end,current_date)) duration,
 CASE WHEN effective_end IS NULL THEN 'Active Assignment' ELSE 'Former Assignment' END status
 FROM staging.stg_workday__worker_position_organization
), stats AS (
 SELECT organization_id,source_relation,count(DISTINCT worker_id) total_employees_ever,count(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE effective_end IS NULL) current_active_employees,count(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE effective_end IS NOT NULL) former_employees,count(DISTINCT position_id) total_positions,count(DISTINCT position_id) FILTER(WHERE effective_end IS NULL) active_positions_count,
 count(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE effective_start>=current_date-INTERVAL '1 year') new_assignments_last_year,count(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE effective_end>=current_date-INTERVAL '1 year') departures_last_year,avg(duration) FILTER(WHERE effective_end IS NULL) avg_current_days,avg(duration) FILTER(WHERE effective_end IS NOT NULL) avg_former_days,max(effective_start) last_activity_date,max(effective_end) last_departure_date
 FROM rel GROUP BY organization_id,source_relation
), roles AS (
 SELECT ow.organization_id,'workday' source_relation,count(DISTINCT r.organization_role_id) unique_organization_roles,count(DISTINCT ow.organization_worker_code) FILTER(WHERE r.organization_role_code ILIKE '%Manager%') management_role_employees,count(DISTINCT ow.organization_worker_code) FILTER(WHERE r.organization_role_code ILIKE '%Director%') director_role_employees,count(DISTINCT ow.organization_worker_code) FILTER(WHERE r.organization_role_code ILIKE '%Lead%') lead_role_employees FROM staging.stg_workday__organization_role_worker ow LEFT JOIN staging.stg_workday__organization_role r ON ow.organization_id=r.organization_id AND ow.role_id=r.organization_role_id GROUP BY ow.organization_id
), perf AS (
 SELECT organization_id,source_relation,avg(overall_employee_score) FILTER(WHERE is_employed) avg_employee_performance_score,avg(career_development_score) FILTER(WHERE is_employed) avg_career_development_score,avg(retention_stability_score) FILTER(WHERE is_employed) avg_retention_stability_score,
 count(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE employee_value_segment='High Value - High Retention') high_value_stable_employees,count(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE employee_value_segment='High Value - Flight Risk') high_value_flight_risk_employees,count(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE employee_value_segment='Stable - Development Needed') stable_development_employees,count(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE employee_value_segment='Development Required') development_required_employees,
 count(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE employee_risk_level='High Risk') high_risk_employees,count(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE employee_risk_level='Medium Risk') medium_risk_employees,count(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE employee_risk_level='Low Risk') low_risk_employees,
 count(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE is_employed AND employee_maturity_segment LIKE '%New Hire%') new_hire_employees,count(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE is_employed AND employee_maturity_segment LIKE '%Junior%') junior_employees,count(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE is_employed AND employee_maturity_segment LIKE '%Experienced%') experienced_employees,count(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE is_employed AND employee_maturity_segment LIKE '%Senior%') senior_employees,count(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE is_employed AND employee_maturity_segment LIKE '%Veteran%') veteran_employees,
 count(DISTINCT ethnicity_codes) FILTER(WHERE is_employed AND ethnicity_codes IS NOT NULL) ethnic_diversity_count,count(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE is_employed AND is_military_service) military_veterans_count,avg(age) FILTER(WHERE is_employed) avg_employee_age,
 count(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE is_employed AND compensation_tier='Entry Level') entry_level_employees,count(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE is_employed AND compensation_tier='Mid Level') mid_level_employees,count(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE is_employed AND compensation_tier='Senior Level') senior_level_employees,count(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE is_employed AND compensation_tier='Executive Level') executive_level_employees,
 sum(total_promotions) FILTER(WHERE is_employed) total_promotions_in_organization,count(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE is_employed AND total_promotions>=2) high_achievers_count,count(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE is_employed AND fast_promotions>0) fast_track_employees_count
 FROM mart.workday__employee_overview WHERE organization_id<>'Unknown' GROUP BY organization_id,source_relation
), joined AS (SELECT o.*,s.*,r.unique_organization_roles,r.management_role_employees,r.director_role_employees,r.lead_role_employees,p.* EXCLUDE(organization_id,source_relation) FROM active_org o LEFT JOIN stats s USING(organization_id,source_relation) LEFT JOIN roles r USING(organization_id,source_relation) LEFT JOIN perf p USING(organization_id,source_relation))
SELECT organization_id,source_relation,organization_name,organization_code,organization_type,organization_sub_type,staffing_model,visibility,
CASE visibility WHEN 'Public' THEN 'Open Access' WHEN 'Private' THEN 'Restricted Access' ELSE 'Unknown Access' END access_level,effective_start organization_created_date,date_diff('day',effective_start,current_date)::BIGINT organization_age_days,round(date_diff('day',effective_start,current_date)/365.0,2)::DOUBLE organization_age_years,
CASE WHEN date_diff('day',effective_start,current_date)<365 THEN 'New' WHEN date_diff('day',effective_start,current_date)<1095 THEN 'Young' WHEN date_diff('day',effective_start,current_date)<3650 THEN 'Mature' ELSE 'Legacy' END organization_maturity_level,
CASE organization_type WHEN 'Company' THEN 'Corporate Level' WHEN 'Division' THEN 'Division Level' WHEN 'Department' THEN 'Department Level' WHEN 'Team' THEN 'Team Level' ELSE 'Other Level' END organizational_level,
coalesce(total_employees_ever,0)::BIGINT total_employees_ever,coalesce(current_active_employees,0)::BIGINT current_active_employees,coalesce(former_employees,0)::BIGINT former_employees,coalesce(total_positions,0)::BIGINT total_positions,coalesce(active_positions_count,0)::BIGINT active_positions_count,
round(coalesce(current_active_employees,0)*100.0/NULLIF(total_positions,0),2)::DOUBLE position_fill_rate,coalesce(new_assignments_last_year,0)::BIGINT new_assignments_last_year,coalesce(departures_last_year,0)::BIGINT departures_last_year,round(coalesce(departures_last_year,0)*100.0/NULLIF(current_active_employees,0),2)::DOUBLE annual_turnover_rate,
round(coalesce(avg_current_days,0)/365.0,2)::DOUBLE avg_current_tenure_years,round(coalesce(avg_former_days,0)/365.0,2)::DOUBLE avg_former_tenure_years,coalesce(unique_organization_roles,0)::BIGINT unique_organization_roles,coalesce(management_role_employees,0)::BIGINT management_role_employees,coalesce(director_role_employees,0)::BIGINT director_role_employees,coalesce(lead_role_employees,0)::BIGINT lead_role_employees,
round((coalesce(management_role_employees,0)+coalesce(director_role_employees,0))*100.0/NULLIF(current_active_employees,0),2)::DOUBLE management_ratio,coalesce(avg_employee_performance_score,0)::DOUBLE avg_employee_performance_score,coalesce(avg_career_development_score,0)::DOUBLE avg_career_development_score,coalesce(avg_retention_stability_score,0)::DOUBLE avg_retention_stability_score,
coalesce(high_value_stable_employees,0)::BIGINT high_value_stable_employees,coalesce(high_value_flight_risk_employees,0)::BIGINT high_value_flight_risk_employees,coalesce(stable_development_employees,0)::BIGINT stable_development_employees,coalesce(development_required_employees,0)::BIGINT development_required_employees,coalesce(high_risk_employees,0)::BIGINT high_risk_employees,coalesce(medium_risk_employees,0)::BIGINT medium_risk_employees,coalesce(low_risk_employees,0)::BIGINT low_risk_employees,
round(coalesce(high_risk_employees,0)*100.0/NULLIF(current_active_employees,0),2)::DOUBLE high_risk_employee_percentage,coalesce(new_hire_employees,0)::BIGINT new_hire_employees,coalesce(junior_employees,0)::BIGINT junior_employees,coalesce(experienced_employees,0)::BIGINT experienced_employees,coalesce(senior_employees,0)::BIGINT senior_employees,coalesce(veteran_employees,0)::BIGINT veteran_employees,coalesce(ethnic_diversity_count,0)::BIGINT ethnic_diversity_count,coalesce(military_veterans_count,0)::BIGINT military_veterans_count,coalesce(avg_employee_age,0)::DOUBLE avg_employee_age,
coalesce(entry_level_employees,0)::BIGINT entry_level_employees,coalesce(mid_level_employees,0)::BIGINT mid_level_employees,coalesce(senior_level_employees,0)::BIGINT senior_level_employees,coalesce(executive_level_employees,0)::BIGINT executive_level_employees,coalesce(total_promotions_in_organization,0)::HUGEINT total_promotions_in_organization,coalesce(high_achievers_count,0)::BIGINT high_achievers_count,coalesce(fast_track_employees_count,0)::BIGINT fast_track_employees_count,
round(least(30,coalesce(avg_employee_performance_score,0)*.3)+CASE WHEN departures_last_year=0 THEN 25 WHEN annual_turnover_rate<=10 THEN 25 WHEN annual_turnover_rate<=20 THEN 20 WHEN annual_turnover_rate<=30 THEN 15 WHEN annual_turnover_rate<=40 THEN 10 ELSE 5 END+least(20,coalesce(avg_career_development_score,0)*.2)+CASE WHEN position_fill_rate>=90 THEN 15 WHEN position_fill_rate>=75 THEN 12 WHEN position_fill_rate>=60 THEN 9 ELSE 6 END+CASE WHEN high_risk_employee_percentage<=10 THEN 10 WHEN high_risk_employee_percentage<=20 THEN 7 WHEN high_risk_employee_percentage<=30 THEN 4 ELSE 2 END,2)::DOUBLE organization_health_score,
CASE WHEN avg_employee_performance_score>=80 THEN 'Excellent' WHEN avg_employee_performance_score>=60 THEN 'Good' WHEN avg_employee_performance_score>=40 THEN 'Average' ELSE 'Needs Improvement' END performance_category,
CASE WHEN current_active_employees=0 THEN 'Empty' WHEN current_active_employees<=5 THEN 'Micro' WHEN current_active_employees<=15 THEN 'Small' WHEN current_active_employees<=50 THEN 'Medium' WHEN current_active_employees<=200 THEN 'Large' ELSE 'Enterprise' END organization_size_category,
coalesce(last_activity_date,effective_start) last_activity_date,coalesce(last_departure_date,DATE '1900-01-01') last_departure_date,
CASE WHEN current_active_employees=0 THEN 'Review Organization Necessity' WHEN annual_turnover_rate>30 THEN 'Focus on Retention' WHEN high_risk_employee_percentage>25 THEN 'Address Employee Risk' WHEN position_fill_rate<70 THEN 'Improve Staffing' WHEN avg_employee_performance_score<50 THEN 'Enhance Performance Management' WHEN management_ratio>40 THEN 'Optimize Structure' ELSE 'Maintain Excellence' END management_recommendation,
CASE WHEN organization_name IS NULL OR trim(organization_name)='' THEN 'ERROR: Missing organization name' WHEN current_active_employees>total_positions+10 THEN 'WARNING: Employees exceed positions' WHEN annual_turnover_rate>100 THEN 'WARNING: Turnover exceeds 100%' WHEN organization_age_days<0 THEN 'ERROR: Negative organization age' ELSE 'VALID' END data_quality_flag,current_timestamp::TIMESTAMPTZ analysis_timestamp
FROM joined

cte_definitions.sql: SELECT worker_id, organization_id, source_relation, position_id, effective_start, effective_end, DATE_DIFF('DAY', effective_start, COALESCE(effective_end, CURRENT_DATE)) AS duration, CASE WHEN effective_end IS NULL THEN 'Active Assignment' ELSE 'Former Assignment' END AS status FROM staging.stg_workday__worker_position_organization

cte_definitions.name: stats
cte_definitions.sql: SELECT organization_id, source_relation, COUNT(DISTINCT worker_id) AS total_employees_ever, COUNT(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE effective_end IS NULL) AS current_active_employees, COUNT(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE NOT effective_end IS NULL) AS former_employees, COUNT(DISTINCT position_id) AS total_positions, COUNT(DISTINCT position_id) FILTER(WHERE effective_end IS NULL) AS active_positions_count, COUNT(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE effective_start >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1' YEAR) AS new_assignments_last_year, COUNT(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE effective_end >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1' YEAR) AS departures_last_year, AVG(duration) FILTER(WHERE effective_end IS NULL) AS avg_current_days, AVG(duration) FILTER(WHERE NOT effective_end IS NULL) AS avg_former_days, MAX(effective_start) AS last_activity_date, MAX(effective_end) AS last_departure_date FROM rel GROUP BY organization_id, source_relation

cte_definitions.name: roles
cte_definitions.sql: SELECT ow.organization_id, 'workday' AS source_relation, COUNT(DISTINCT r.organization_role_id) AS unique_organization_roles, COUNT(DISTINCT ow.organization_worker_code) FILTER(WHERE r.organization_role_code ILIKE '%Manager%') AS management_role_employees, COUNT(DISTINCT ow.organization_worker_code) FILTER(WHERE r.organization_role_code ILIKE '%Director%') AS director_role_employees, COUNT(DISTINCT ow.organization_worker_code) FILTER(WHERE r.organization_role_code ILIKE '%Lead%') AS lead_role_employees FROM staging.stg_workday__organization_role_worker AS ow LEFT JOIN staging.stg_workday__organization_role AS r ON ow.organization_id = r.organization_id AND ow.role_id = r.organization_role_id GROUP BY ow.organization_id

cte_definitions.name: perf
cte_definitions.sql: SELECT organization_id, source_relation, AVG(overall_employee_score) FILTER(WHERE is_employed) AS avg_employee_performance_score, AVG(career_development_score) FILTER(WHERE is_employed) AS avg_career_development_score, AVG(retention_stability_score) FILTER(WHERE is_employed) AS avg_retention_stability_score, COUNT(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE employee_value_segment = 'High Value - High Retention') AS high_value_stable_employees, COUNT(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE employee_value_segment = 'High Value - Flight Risk') AS high_value_flight_risk_employees, COUNT(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE employee_value_segment = 'Stable - Development Needed') AS stable_development_employees, COUNT(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE employee_value_segment = 'Development Required') AS development_required_employees, COUNT(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE employee_risk_level = 'High Risk') AS high_risk_employees, COUNT(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE employee_risk_level = 'Medium Risk') AS medium_risk_employees, COUNT(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE employee_risk_level = 'Low Risk') AS low_risk_employees, COUNT(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE is_employed AND employee_maturity_segment LIKE '%New Hire%') AS new_hire_employees, COUNT(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE is_employed AND employee_maturity_segment LIKE '%Junior%') AS junior_employees, COUNT(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE is_employed AND employee_maturity_segment LIKE '%Experienced%') AS experienced_employees, COUNT(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE is_employed AND employee_maturity_segment LIKE '%Senior%') AS senior_employees, COUNT(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE is_employed AND employee_maturity_segment LIKE '%Veteran%') AS veteran_employees, COUNT(DISTINCT ethnicity_codes) FILTER(WHERE is_employed AND NOT ethnicity_codes IS NULL) AS ethnic_diversity_count, COUNT(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE is_employed AND is_military_service) AS military_veterans_count, AVG(age) FILTER(WHERE is_employed) AS avg_employee_age, COUNT(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE is_employed AND compensation_tier = 'Entry Level') AS entry_level_employees, COUNT(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE is_employed AND compensation_tier = 'Mid Level') AS mid_level_employees, COUNT(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE is_employed AND compensation_tier = 'Senior Level') AS senior_level_employees, COUNT(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE is_employed AND compensation_tier = 'Executive Level') AS executive_level_employees, SUM(total_promotions) FILTER(WHERE is_employed) AS total_promotions_in_organization, COUNT(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE is_employed AND total_promotions >= 2) AS high_achievers_count, COUNT(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE is_employed AND fast_promotions > 0) AS fast_track_employees_count FROM mart.workday__employee_overview WHERE organization_id <> 'Unknown' GROUP BY organization_id, source_relation

cte_definitions.name: joined
cte_definitions.sql: SELECT o.*, s.*, r.unique_organization_roles, r.management_role_employees, r.director_role_employees, r.lead_role_employees, p.* EXCLUDE (organization_id, source_relation) FROM active_org AS o LEFT JOIN stats AS s USING (organization_id, source_relation) LEFT JOIN roles AS r USING (organization_id, source_relation) LEFT JOIN perf AS p USING (organization_id, source_relation)

- name: workday__organization_overview
      description: Executive-ready overview of each active organization with headcount, roles, tenure, mobility, risk, performance, diversity, compensation tiers, promotions, derived scores, recommendations, and data quality
      grain: One row per active organization_id and source_relation
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_workday__organization (filtered to is_inactive = false)
      - staging.stg_workday__worker_position_organization
      - staging.stg_workday__organization_role_worker
      - staging.stg_workday__organization_role
      - mart.workday__employee_overview (filtered to organization_id != 'Unknown')
      business_logic: '1) Filter organizations to active only and expose attributes and effective_start as the creation date. 2) Build worker–organization–role relationships by left joining worker positions to role-worker and role master on matching worker, role, source_relation, and organization_id. For each assignment: - assignment_status: ''Active Assignment'' if end date is null, else ''Former Assignment''. - assignment_duration_days: days between start and end; if end is null, days between start and current_date. - carry organization_role_id and organization_role_code from the role join. 3) Aggregate organization_employee_stats by (organization_id, source_relation): - total_employees_ever: distinct workers across all assignments. - current_active_employees: distinct workers with Active Assignment. - former_employees: distinct workers with Former Assignment. - total_positions_in_org: distinct positions across all assignments. - active_positions_count: distinct positions with Active Assignment. - new_assignments_last_year: distinct workers with start date in the last year relative to current_date. - departures_last_year: distinct workers with a non-null end date in the last year. - avg_current_tenure_days: average assignment_duration_days for Active Assignments. - avg_former_tenure_days: average assignment_duration_days for Former Assignments. - unique_organization_roles: distinct organization_role_id. - management_role_employees / director_role_employees / lead_role_employees: distinct workers where role code contains ''Manager'' / ''Director'' / ''Lead''. - last_new_assignment_date: most recent start date; last_departure_date: most recent end date. 4) Aggregate organization_performance_metrics from mart.workday__employee_overview by (organization_id, source_relation), excluding organization_id = ''Unknown'': - Averages over currently employed workers only: overall_employee_score and career_development_score rounded to 2 decimals; retention_stability_score rounded to 2 decimals; age rounded to 1 decimal. - Employee value segments: distinct workers by segment (''High Value - High Retention'', ''High Value - Flight Risk'', ''Stable - Development Needed'', ''Development Required''); no employment filter. - Risk distribution: distinct workers by employee_risk_level (High/Medium/Low); no employment filter. - Maturity segments: distinct employed workers where maturity contains ''New Hire'' / ''Junior'' / ''Experienced'' / ''Senior'' / ''Veteran''. - Diversity: distinct ethnicity_codes among employed; military_veterans_count is distinct employed workers flagged for military service. - Compensation tiers: distinct employed workers by compensation_tier (Entry/Mid/Senior/Executive Level). - Promotions among employed: total_promotions summed; high_achievers_count is distinct workers with total_promotions ≥ 2; fast_track_employees_count is distinct workers with fast_promotions > 0. 5) Derive organization attributes per active organization: - organization_created_date from effective_start. - organization_age_days as days from creation to current_date; organization_age_years is that divided by 365, rounded to 2 decimals. - organization_maturity_level by age_days: <1 year New; 1–3 years Young; 3–10 years Mature; 10+ years Legacy. - organizational_level from organization_type: Company/Division/Department/Team mapped to corresponding Level; others to Other Level. - access_level from visibility: Public→Open Access, Private→Restricted Access, others Unknown Access. 6) Final metrics and rules (rates rounded to 2 decimals; missing metrics default to 0 unless noted): - position_fill_rate (%) = current_active_employees ÷ total_positions × 100 when total_positions > 0, else 0. - annual_turnover_rate (%) = departures_last_year ÷ current_active_employees × 100 when current_active_employees > 0, else 0. - avg_current_tenure_years and avg_former_tenure_years = respective average tenure days ÷ 365, rounded to 2; if no data, treated as 0. - management_ratio (%) = (management_role_employees + director_role_employees) ÷ current_active_employees × 100 when current_active_employees > 0, else 0. - high_risk_employee_percentage (%) = high_risk_employees ÷ current_active_employees × 100 when current_active_employees > 0, else 0. - organization_health_score (0–100) = sum of: performance (cap at 30% of average performance), turnover (25/20/15/10/5 by thresholds using annual_turnover_rate and zero departures case), development (cap at 20% of average career development), efficiency (15/12/9/6 by position_fill_rate thresholds), and risk (10/7/4/2 by high_risk_employee_percentage thresholds); final score rounded to 2 decimals. - performance_category uses a weighted composite with thresholds: Excellent if composite ≥ 80; else Good if ≥ 60; else Average if ≥ 40; otherwise Needs Improvement (weights and constants follow the detailed rules above). - organization_size_category by current_active_employees: 0 Empty; ≤5 Micro; ≤15 Small; ≤50 Medium; ≤200 Large; else Enterprise. - last_activity_date is the most recent assignment start; if none, use organization_created_date. - last_departure_date is the most recent assignment end; if none, use 1900-01-01. - management_recommendation (first match): if no active employees then review necessity; else if turnover > 30% then focus on retention; else if high-risk % > 25% then address risk; else if fill rate < 70% then improve staffing; else if average performance < 50 then enhance performance management; else if management_ratio > 40% then optimize structure; else maintain excellence. - data_quality_flag precedence: missing or blank organization name → ERROR; active employees exceed positions by more than 10 → WARNING; turnover rate > 100% → WARNING; negative age days → ERROR; otherwise VALID. - analysis_timestamp is the query execution timestamp. 7) Join logic: left join employee stats and performance metrics to active organizations on (organization_id, source_relation); missing measures default to 0. The final ordering is for presentation only and does not affect grain.'
      columns:
      - name: organization_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Organization identifier; join key to stats and metrics; one output row per active (organization_id, source_relation)
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source system code carried from staging and used in all joins
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: organization_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Organization display name from the active organization record
      - name: organization_code
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Organization code from the active organization record
      - name: organization_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Organization type (e.g., Company, Division, Department, Team)
      - name: organization_sub_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Subtype of the organization if provided in source
      - name: staffing_model
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Staffing model from source organization attributes
      - name: visibility
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Visibility setting from source; drives access_level mapping
      - name: access_level
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Derived access control: Public→Open Access, Private→Restricted Access, else Unknown Access'
      - name: organization_created_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Effective start date of the active organization record
      - name: organization_age_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Days since organization_created_date to current_date at run time
      - name: organization_age_years
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Rounded years since creation = round(organization_age_days/365.0, 2)
      - name: organization_maturity_level
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Age bucket: <1y New; 1–3y Young; 3–10y Mature; 10+y Legacy based on organization_age_days'
      - name: organizational_level
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Level mapped from organization_type: Company/Division/Department/Team→Corporate/Division/Department/Team Level; else Other Level'
      - name: total_employees_ever
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct workers ever assigned to the org; defaults to 0 when missing
      - name: current_active_employees
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct workers with Active Assignment at run time; defaults to 0 when missing
      - name: former_employees
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct workers with Former Assignment; defaults to 0 when missing
      - name: total_positions
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct positions ever assigned within the org; defaults to 0 when missing
      - name: active_positions_count
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct positions with Active Assignment; defaults to 0 when missing
      - name: position_fill_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Filled positions % = round(current_active_employees*100.0/total_positions, 2); 0 if total_positions=0
      - name: new_assignments_last_year
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct workers with assignment start in the last year; defaults to 0 when missing
      - name: departures_last_year
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct workers with non-null assignment end in the last year; defaults to 0 when missing
      - name: annual_turnover_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Departures % = round(departures_last_year*100.0/current_active_employees, 2); 0 if denominator=0
      - name: avg_current_tenure_years
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average tenure (years) for Active Assignments = round(avg_current_tenure_days/365.0, 2) with NULL→0
      - name: avg_former_tenure_years
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average tenure (years) for Former Assignments = round(avg_former_tenure_days/365.0, 2) with NULL→0
      - name: unique_organization_roles
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct organization_role_id linked to the org; defaults to 0 when missing
      - name: management_role_employees
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct workers with role code containing 'Manager'; defaults to 0 when missing
      - name: director_role_employees
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct workers with role code containing 'Director'; defaults to 0 when missing
      - name: lead_role_employees
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct workers with role code containing 'Lead'; defaults to 0 when missing
      - name: management_ratio
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Management share % = round((management_role_employees+director_role_employees)*100.0/current_active_employees, 2); 0 if denominator=0
      - name: avg_employee_performance_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Avg overall_employee_score among employed, rounded to 2; defaults to 0 when missing; 0–100 scale preserved
      - name: avg_career_development_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Avg career_development_score among employed, rounded to 2; defaults to 0 when missing; 0–100 scale preserved
      - name: avg_retention_stability_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Avg retention_stability_score among employed, rounded to 2; defaults to 0 when missing; 0–100 scale preserved
      - name: high_value_stable_employees
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct workers in 'High Value - High Retention'; defaults to 0 when missing
      - name: high_value_flight_risk_employees
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct workers in 'High Value - Flight Risk'; defaults to 0 when missing
      - name: stable_development_employees
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct workers in 'Stable - Development Needed'; defaults to 0 when missing
      - name: development_required_employees
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct workers in 'Development Required'; defaults to 0 when missing
      - name: high_risk_employees
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct workers with employee_risk_level = 'High Risk'; defaults to 0 when missing
      - name: medium_risk_employees
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct workers with employee_risk_level = 'Medium Risk'; defaults to 0 when missing
      - name: low_risk_employees
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct workers with employee_risk_level = 'Low Risk'; defaults to 0 when missing
      - name: high_risk_employee_percentage
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: High-risk share % = round(high_risk_employees*100.0/current_active_employees, 2); 0 if denominator=0
      - name: new_hire_employees
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct employed workers with maturity containing 'New Hire'; defaults to 0 when missing
      - name: junior_employees
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct employed workers with maturity containing 'Junior'; defaults to 0 when missing
      - name: experienced_employees
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct employed workers with maturity containing 'Experienced'; defaults to 0 when missing
      - name: senior_employees
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct employed workers with maturity containing 'Senior'; defaults to 0 when missing
      - name: veteran_employees
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct employed workers with maturity containing 'Veteran'; defaults to 0 when missing
      - name: ethnic_diversity_count
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of distinct ethnicity_codes among employed; defaults to 0 when missing
      - name: military_veterans_count
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct employed workers with military service flag; defaults to 0 when missing
      - name: avg_employee_age
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average age among employed, rounded to 1 in source aggregation; defaults to 0 when missing
      - name: entry_level_employees
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct employed workers in compensation_tier = 'Entry Level'; defaults to 0 when missing
      - name: mid_level_employees
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct employed workers in compensation_tier = 'Mid Level'; defaults to 0 when missing
      - name: senior_level_employees
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct employed workers in compensation_tier = 'Senior Level'; defaults to 0 when missing
      - name: executive_level_employees
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct employed workers in compensation_tier = 'Executive Level'; defaults to 0 when missing
      - name: total_promotions_in_organization
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of total_promotions for employed workers in the org; defaults to 0 when missing
      - name: high_achievers_count
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct employed workers with total_promotions >= 2; defaults to 0 when missing
      - name: fast_track_employees_count
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct employed workers with fast_promotions > 0; defaults to 0 when missing
      - name: organization_health_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Composite 0–100 score from performance, turnover, development, fill-rate efficiency, and risk components; rounded to 2
      - name: performance_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Category from the weighted composite: Excellent (>=80), Good (>=60), Average (>=40), else Needs Improvement'
      - name: organization_size_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Size bucket by current_active_employees: Empty, Micro (<=5), Small (<=15), Medium (<=50), Large (<=200), Enterprise (>200)'
      - name: last_activity_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Most recent assignment start date; if none, falls back to organization_created_date
      - name: last_departure_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Most recent assignment end date; if none, defaults to 1900-01-01
      - name: management_recommendation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Recommendation based on thresholds of size, turnover, high-risk %, fill rate, performance, and management ratio; first matching rule applies
      - name: data_quality_flag
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: VALID or specific ERROR/WARNING based on missing name, employee>position anomaly, turnover >100%, or negative age days
      - name: analysis_timestamp
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: current_timestamp at run time indicating when the analysis was computed

columns.name: organization_maturity_level
columns.description: Age bucket: <1y New; 1–3y Young; 3–10y Mature; 10+y Legacy based on organization_age_days

columns.name: organizational_level
columns.description: Level mapped from organization_type: Company/Division/Department/Team→Corporate/Division/Department/Team Level; else Other Level

columns.name: total_employees_ever
columns.description: Distinct workers ever assigned to the org; defaults to 0 when missing

columns.name: current_active_employees
columns.description: Distinct workers with Active Assignment at run time; defaults to 0 when missing

columns.name: former_employees
columns.description: Distinct workers with Former Assignment; defaults to 0 when missing

columns.name: total_positions
columns.description: Distinct positions ever assigned within the org; defaults to 0 when missing

columns.name: active_positions_count
columns.description: Distinct positions with Active Assignment; defaults to 0 when missing

columns.name: position_fill_rate
columns.description: Filled positions % = round(current_active_employees*100.0/total_positions, 2); 0 if total_positions=0

columns.name: new_assignments_last_year
columns.description: Distinct workers with assignment start in the last year; defaults to 0 when missing

columns.name: departures_last_year
columns.description: Distinct workers with non-null assignment end in the last year; defaults to 0 when missing

columns.name: annual_turnover_rate
columns.description: Departures % = round(departures_last_year*100.0/current_active_employees, 2); 0 if denominator=0

columns.name: avg_current_tenure_years
columns.description: Average tenure (years) for Active Assignments = round(avg_current_tenure_days/365.0, 2) with NULL→0

columns.name: avg_former_tenure_years
columns.description: Average tenure (years) for Former Assignments = round(avg_former_tenure_days/365.0, 2) with NULL→0

columns.name: unique_organization_roles
columns.description: Distinct organization_role_id linked to the org; defaults to 0 when missing

columns.name: management_role_employees
columns.description: Distinct workers with role code containing 'Manager'; defaults to 0 when missing

columns.name: director_role_employees
columns.description: Distinct workers with role code containing 'Director'; defaults to 0 when missing

columns.name: lead_role_employees
columns.description: Distinct workers with role code containing 'Lead'; defaults to 0 when missing

columns.name: management_ratio
columns.description: Management share % = round((management_role_employees+director_role_employees)*100.0/current_active_employees, 2); 0 if denominator=0

columns.name: avg_employee_performance_score
columns.description: Avg overall_employee_score among employed, rounded to 2; defaults to 0 when missing; 0–100 scale preserved

columns.name: avg_career_development_score
columns.description: Avg career_development_score among employed, rounded to 2; defaults to 0 when missing; 0–100 scale preserved

columns.name: avg_retention_stability_score
columns.description: Avg retention_stability_score among employed, rounded to 2; defaults to 0 when missing; 0–100 scale preserved

columns.name: high_value_stable_employees
columns.description: Distinct workers in 'High Value - High Retention'; defaults to 0 when missing

columns.name: high_value_flight_risk_employees
columns.description: Distinct workers in 'High Value - Flight Risk'; defaults to 0 when missing

columns.name: stable_development_employees
columns.description: Distinct workers in 'Stable - Development Needed'; defaults to 0 when missing

columns.name: development_required_employees
columns.description: Distinct workers in 'Development Required'; defaults to 0 when missing

columns.name: high_risk_employees
columns.description: Distinct workers with employee_risk_level = 'High Risk'; defaults to 0 when missing

columns.name: medium_risk_employees
columns.description: Distinct workers with employee_risk_level = 'Medium Risk'; defaults to 0 when missing

columns.name: low_risk_employees
columns.description: Distinct workers with employee_risk_level = 'Low Risk'; defaults to 0 when missing

columns.name: high_risk_employee_percentage
columns.description: High-risk share % = round(high_risk_employees*100.0/current_active_employees, 2); 0 if denominator=0

columns.name: new_hire_employees
columns.description: Distinct employed workers with maturity containing 'New Hire'; defaults to 0 when missing

columns.name: junior_employees
columns.description: Distinct employed workers with maturity containing 'Junior'; defaults to 0 when missing

columns.name: experienced_employees
columns.description: Distinct employed workers with maturity containing 'Experienced'; defaults to 0 when missing

columns.name: senior_employees
columns.description: Distinct employed workers with maturity containing 'Senior'; defaults to 0 when missing

columns.name: veteran_employees
columns.description: Distinct employed workers with maturity containing 'Veteran'; defaults to 0 when missing

columns.name: ethnic_diversity_count
columns.description: Count of distinct ethnicity_codes among employed; defaults to 0 when missing

columns.name: military_veterans_count
columns.description: Distinct employed workers with military service flag; defaults to 0 when missing

columns.name: avg_employee_age
columns.description: Average age among employed, rounded to 1 in source aggregation; defaults to 0 when missing

columns.name: entry_level_employees
columns.description: Distinct employed workers in compensation_tier = 'Entry Level'; defaults to 0 when missing

columns.name: mid_level_employees
columns.description: Distinct employed workers in compensation_tier = 'Mid Level'; defaults to 0 when missing

columns.name: senior_level_employees
columns.description: Distinct employed workers in compensation_tier = 'Senior Level'; defaults to 0 when missing

columns.name: executive_level_employees
columns.description: Distinct employed workers in compensation_tier = 'Executive Level'; defaults to 0 when missing

columns.name: total_promotions_in_organization
columns.description: Sum of total_promotions for employed workers in the org; defaults to 0 when missing

columns.name: high_achievers_count
columns.description: Distinct employed workers with total_promotions >= 2; defaults to 0 when missing

columns.name: fast_track_employees_count
columns.description: Distinct employed workers with fast_promotions > 0; defaults to 0 when missing

columns.name: organization_health_score
columns.description: Composite 0–100 score from performance, turnover, development, fill-rate efficiency, and risk components; rounded to 2

columns.name: performance_category
columns.description: Category from the weighted composite: Excellent (>=80), Good (>=60), Average (>=40), else Needs Improvement

columns.name: organization_size_category
columns.description: Size bucket by current_active_employees: Empty, Micro (<=5), Small (<=15), Medium (<=50), Large (<=200), Enterprise (>200)

columns.name: last_activity_date
columns.description: Most recent assignment start date; if none, falls back to organization_created_date

columns.name: last_departure_date
columns.description: Most recent assignment end date; if none, defaults to 1900-01-01

columns.name: management_recommendation
columns.description: Recommendation based on thresholds of size, turnover, high-risk %, fill rate, performance, and management ratio; first matching rule applies

columns.name: data_quality_flag
columns.description: VALID or specific ERROR/WARNING based on missing name, employee>position anomaly, turnover >100%, or negative age days

columns.name: analysis_timestamp
columns.description: current_timestamp at run time indicating when the analysis was computed

WITH base AS (SELECT * FROM staging.stg_workday__position), history AS (
 SELECT position_id,source_relation,count(DISTINCT worker_id) total_workers_ever_assigned,count(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE effective_end IS NULL) current_workers_assigned,count(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE effective_end IS NOT NULL) former_workers_assigned,
 avg(date_diff('day',effective_start,coalesce(effective_end,current_date))) avg_tenure_days,max(effective_start) last_assignment_date,max(effective_end) last_departure_date,
 count(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE effective_start>=current_date-INTERVAL '1 year') new_assignments_last_year,count(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE effective_end>=current_date-INTERVAL '1 year') departures_last_year
 FROM staging.stg_workday__worker_position GROUP BY position_id,source_relation
), po AS (
 SELECT position_id,source_relation,organization_id,effective_end,row_number() over(partition by position_id,source_relation order by effective_start desc) rn FROM staging.stg_workday__position_organization
), profiles AS (
 SELECT pjp.position_id,pjp.source_relation,pjp.job_profile_id,jp.job_profile_title,jp.management_level,jp.compensation_grade_id,jp.is_work_shift_required,jp.is_union_eligible FROM staging.stg_workday__position_job_profile pjp LEFT JOIN staging.stg_workday__job_profile jp USING(job_profile_id,source_relation)
), orgs AS (
 SELECT organization_id,source_relation,organization_name,organization_type,organization_sub_type,staffing_model,current_employee_count,organization_health_score,annual_turnover_rate,performance_category,organization_size_category FROM intermediate.int_workday__organization_metrics
), similar_positions AS (
 SELECT po.organization_id,pr.job_profile_id,count(DISTINCT b.position_id) similar_positions_in_department FROM base b LEFT JOIN po ON b.position_id=po.position_id AND b.source_relation=po.source_relation AND po.rn=1 LEFT JOIN profiles pr ON b.position_id=pr.position_id AND b.source_relation=pr.source_relation GROUP BY po.organization_id,pr.job_profile_id
), emp AS (
 SELECT position_id,source_relation,avg(overall_employee_score) FILTER(WHERE is_employed) avg_employee_performance_score,avg(career_development_score) FILTER(WHERE is_employed) avg_career_development_score,avg(retention_stability_score) FILTER(WHERE is_employed) avg_retention_score,
 count(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE employee_risk_level='High Risk') high_risk_employees_count,count(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE employee_risk_level='Medium Risk') medium_risk_employees_count,count(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE employee_risk_level='Low Risk') low_risk_employees_count,count(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE employee_value_segment='High Value - High Retention') high_value_employees_count,count(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE employee_value_segment='High Value - Flight Risk') flight_risk_employees_count,
 count(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE is_employed AND employee_maturity_segment LIKE '%New Hire%') new_employees_count,count(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE is_employed AND employee_maturity_segment LIKE '%Veteran%') veteran_employees_count,avg(age) FILTER(WHERE is_employed) avg_employee_age,count(DISTINCT ethnicity_codes) FILTER(WHERE is_employed AND ethnicity_codes IS NOT NULL) ethnic_diversity_count,count(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE is_employed AND is_military_service) military_veterans_count
 FROM mart.workday__employee_overview GROUP BY position_id,source_relation
), joined AS (
 SELECT b.*,coalesce(h.total_workers_ever_assigned,0) total_workers_ever_assigned,coalesce(h.current_workers_assigned,0) current_workers_assigned,coalesce(h.former_workers_assigned,0) former_workers_assigned,coalesce(h.avg_tenure_days,0) avg_tenure_days,h.last_assignment_date,h.last_departure_date,coalesce(h.new_assignments_last_year,0) new_assignments_last_year,coalesce(h.departures_last_year,0) departures_last_year,
 coalesce(po.organization_id,'Unknown') organization_id,coalesce(o.organization_name,'Unknown') organization_name,coalesce(o.organization_type,'Unknown') organization_type,coalesce(o.organization_sub_type,'Unknown') organization_sub_type,coalesce(o.staffing_model,'Unknown') staffing_model,coalesce(o.current_employee_count,0) department_total_employees,coalesce(o.organization_health_score,0) department_health_score,coalesce(o.annual_turnover_rate,0) department_turnover_rate,coalesce(o.performance_category,'Unknown') department_performance_level,coalesce(o.organization_size_category,'Unknown') department_size_category,
 coalesce(pr.job_profile_id,'Unknown') job_profile_id,coalesce(pr.job_profile_title,'Unknown') job_profile_title,coalesce(pr.management_level,'Unknown') management_level,coalesce(pr.compensation_grade_id,'Ungraded') compensation_grade_id,coalesce(pr.is_work_shift_required,FALSE) is_work_shift_required,coalesce(pr.is_union_eligible,FALSE) is_union_eligible,
 coalesce(s.similar_positions_in_department,0) similar_positions_in_department,coalesce(e.avg_employee_performance_score,0) avg_employee_performance_score,coalesce(e.avg_career_development_score,0) avg_career_development_score,coalesce(e.avg_retention_score,0) avg_retention_score,coalesce(e.high_risk_employees_count,0) high_risk_employees_count,coalesce(e.medium_risk_employees_count,0) medium_risk_employees_count,coalesce(e.low_risk_employees_count,0) low_risk_employees_count,coalesce(e.high_value_employees_count,0) high_value_employees_count,coalesce(e.flight_risk_employees_count,0) flight_risk_employees_count,coalesce(e.new_employees_count,0) new_employees_count,coalesce(e.veteran_employees_count,0) veteran_employees_count,coalesce(e.avg_employee_age,0) avg_employee_age,coalesce(e.ethnic_diversity_count,0) ethnic_diversity_count,coalesce(e.military_veterans_count,0) military_veterans_count
 FROM base b LEFT JOIN history h USING(position_id,source_relation) LEFT JOIN po ON b.position_id=po.position_id AND b.source_relation=po.source_relation AND po.rn=1 LEFT JOIN orgs o ON po.organization_id=o.organization_id AND po.source_relation=o.source_relation LEFT JOIN profiles pr USING(position_id,source_relation) LEFT JOIN similar_positions s ON po.organization_id=s.organization_id AND pr.job_profile_id=s.job_profile_id LEFT JOIN emp e USING(position_id,source_relation)
), final AS (
 SELECT *,date_diff('day',effective_start,current_date)::BIGINT position_age_days,coalesce(last_assignment_date,effective_start) last_assignment_date_out,
 CASE WHEN regexp_extract(compensation_grade_id,'([0-9]+)',1)='' THEN 'Ungraded' WHEN try_cast(regexp_extract(compensation_grade_id,'([0-9]+)',1) AS INTEGER)<=5 THEN 'Entry Level' WHEN try_cast(regexp_extract(compensation_grade_id,'([0-9]+)',1) AS INTEGER)<=10 THEN 'Mid Level' WHEN try_cast(regexp_extract(compensation_grade_id,'([0-9]+)',1) AS INTEGER)<=15 THEN 'Senior Level' ELSE 'Executive Level' END compensation_tier
 FROM joined
)
SELECT position_id,source_relation,business_title,employee_type,default_weekly_hours,effective_start position_created_date,position_age_days,
CASE WHEN position_age_days<90 THEN 'New Position (<3 months)' WHEN position_age_days<365 THEN 'Recent Position (3-12 months)' WHEN position_age_days<730 THEN 'Established Position (1-2 years)' WHEN position_age_days<1825 THEN 'Mature Position (2-5 years)' ELSE 'Legacy Position (5+ years)' END position_age_category,
total_workers_ever_assigned,current_workers_assigned,former_workers_assigned,CASE WHEN current_workers_assigned>0 THEN 'Occupied' WHEN total_workers_ever_assigned>0 THEN 'Vacant (Previously Occupied)' ELSE 'Vacant (Never Occupied)' END position_occupancy_status,round(avg_tenure_days/365.0,2)::DOUBLE avg_tenure_years_in_position,last_assignment_date_out last_assignment_date,last_departure_date,new_assignments_last_year,departures_last_year,CASE WHEN total_workers_ever_assigned=0 THEN 0 ELSE round(departures_last_year*100.0/total_workers_ever_assigned,2) END::DOUBLE position_turnover_rate,
organization_id,organization_name,organization_type,organization_sub_type,staffing_model,department_total_employees,department_health_score,department_turnover_rate,department_performance_level,department_size_category,similar_positions_in_department,job_profile_id,job_profile_title,management_level,compensation_grade_id,compensation_tier,is_work_shift_required,is_union_eligible,
(CASE WHEN is_work_shift_required THEN 1 ELSE 0 END+CASE WHEN is_union_eligible THEN 1 ELSE 0 END+CASE WHEN default_weekly_hours>40 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::INTEGER challenging_work_conditions_score,
CASE management_level WHEN 'Director' THEN 4 WHEN 'Senior Manager' THEN 3 WHEN 'Manager' THEN 2 WHEN 'Individual Contributor' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END::INTEGER management_level_numeric,round(avg_employee_performance_score,2)::DOUBLE avg_employee_performance_score,round(avg_career_development_score,2)::DOUBLE avg_career_development_score,round(avg_retention_score,2)::DOUBLE avg_retention_score,
high_risk_employees_count,medium_risk_employees_count,low_risk_employees_count,high_value_employees_count,flight_risk_employees_count,new_employees_count,veteran_employees_count,round(avg_employee_age,1)::DOUBLE avg_employee_age,ethnic_diversity_count,military_veterans_count,
round((CASE WHEN current_workers_assigned>0 THEN 25 ELSE 0 END+CASE WHEN avg_tenure_days>=730 THEN 25 WHEN avg_tenure_days>=365 THEN 20 WHEN avg_tenure_days>=180 THEN 15 ELSE 10 END+least(30,avg_employee_performance_score*.3)+least(20,department_health_score*.2)),2)::DOUBLE position_efficiency_score,
CASE WHEN current_workers_assigned=0 THEN 'Vacant Position' WHEN avg_employee_performance_score>=80 AND avg_tenure_days>=730 THEN 'High-Performance Stable Position' WHEN avg_employee_performance_score>=70 THEN 'High-Performance Position' WHEN avg_tenure_days>=730 THEN 'Stable Position' WHEN departures_last_year>1 THEN 'High-Turnover Position' ELSE 'Standard Position' END position_performance_category,
CASE WHEN current_workers_assigned=0 AND position_age_days>180 THEN 'Review Position Necessity' WHEN high_risk_employees_count>0 THEN 'Focus on Retention' WHEN avg_employee_performance_score<50 THEN 'Performance Improvement Needed' WHEN department_health_score<50 THEN 'Department Support Needed' WHEN avg_employee_performance_score>=80 THEN 'Maintain Excellence' ELSE 'Standard Management' END management_priority,
CASE WHEN current_workers_assigned=0 THEN 'No Current Cost' WHEN default_weekly_hours>40 AND avg_employee_performance_score<60 THEN 'High Cost - Low Performance' WHEN default_weekly_hours>40 AND avg_employee_performance_score>=80 THEN 'High Cost - High Performance' WHEN default_weekly_hours<=40 AND avg_employee_performance_score>=80 THEN 'Optimal Cost-Performance' ELSE 'Standard Cost-Performance' END cost_performance_analysis,
CASE WHEN current_workers_assigned=0 AND position_age_days>365 THEN 'Consider Position Elimination' WHEN similar_positions_in_department>5 THEN 'Consider Position Consolidation' WHEN flight_risk_employees_count>0 THEN 'Develop Succession Plan' WHEN avg_employee_performance_score>=90 THEN 'Consider Position Expansion' ELSE 'Maintain Current Structure' END strategic_recommendation,
CASE WHEN business_title IS NULL OR trim(business_title)='' THEN 'ERROR: Missing title' WHEN default_weekly_hours<=0 THEN 'ERROR: Invalid weekly hours' WHEN position_age_days<0 THEN 'ERROR: Future position date' WHEN default_weekly_hours>80 OR current_workers_assigned>3 THEN 'WARNING: Position anomaly' ELSE 'VALID' END data_quality_flag,current_timestamp::TIMESTAMPTZ analysis_timestamp
FROM final

total_workers_ever_assigned,current_workers_assigned,former_workers_assigned,CASE WHEN current_workers_assigned>0 THEN 'Occupied' WHEN total_workers_ever_assigned>0 THEN 'Vacant (Previously Occupied)' ELSE 'Vacant (Never Occupied)' END position_occupancy_status,round(avg_tenure_days/365.0,2)::DOUBLE avg_tenure_years_in_position,last_assignment_date_out last_assignment_date,last_departure_date,new_assignments_last_year,departures_last_year,CASE WHEN total_workers_ever_assigned=0 THEN 0 ELSE round(departures_last_year*100.0/total_workers_ever_assigned,2) END::DOUBLE position_turnover_rate,
organization_id,organization_name,organization_type,organization_sub_type,staffing_model,department_total_employees,department_health_score,department_turnover_rate,department_performance_level,department_size_category,similar_positions_in_department,job_profile_id,job_profile_title,management_level,compensation_grade_id,compensation_tier,is_work_shift_required,is_union_eligible,
(CASE WHEN is_work_shift_required THEN 1 ELSE 0 END+CASE WHEN is_union_eligible THEN 1 ELSE 0 END+CASE WHEN default_weekly_hours>40 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::INTEGER challenging_work_conditions_score,
CASE management_level WHEN 'Director' THEN 4 WHEN 'Senior Manager' THEN 3 WHEN 'Manager' THEN 2 WHEN 'Individual Contributor' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END::INTEGER management_level_numeric,round(avg_employee_performance_score,2)::DOUBLE avg_employee_performance_score,round(avg_career_development_score,2)::DOUBLE avg_career_development_score,round(avg_retention_score,2)::DOUBLE avg_retention_score,
high_risk_employees_count,medium_risk_employees_count,low_risk_employees_count,high_value_employees_count,flight_risk_employees_count,new_employees_count,veteran_employees_count,round(avg_employee_age,1)::DOUBLE avg_employee_age,ethnic_diversity_count,military_veterans_count,
round((CASE WHEN current_workers_assigned>0 THEN 25 ELSE 0 END+CASE WHEN avg_tenure_days>=730 THEN 25 WHEN avg_tenure_days>=365 THEN 20 WHEN avg_tenure_days>=180 THEN 15 ELSE 10 END+least(30,avg_employee_performance_score*.3)+least(20,department_health_score*.2)),2)::DOUBLE position_efficiency_score,
CASE WHEN current_workers_assigned=0 THEN 'Vacant Position' WHEN avg_employee_performance_score>=80 AND avg_tenure_days>=730 THEN 'High-Performance Stable Position' WHEN avg_employee_performance_score>=70 THEN 'High-Performance Position' WHEN avg_tenure_days>=730 THEN 'Stable Position' WHEN departures_last_year>1 THEN 'High-Turnover Position' ELSE 'Standard Position' END position_performance_category,
CASE WHEN current_workers_assigned=0 AND position_age_days>180 THEN 'Review Position Necessity' WHEN high_risk_employees_count>0 THEN 'Focus on Retention' WHEN avg_employee_performance_score<50 THEN 'Performance Improvement Needed' WHEN department_health_score<50 THEN 'Department Support Needed' WHEN avg_employee_performance_score>=80 THEN 'Maintain Excellence' ELSE 'Standard Management' END management_priority,
CASE WHEN current_workers_assigned=0 THEN 'No Current Cost' WHEN default_weekly_hours>40 AND avg_employee_performance_score<60 THEN 'High Cost - Low Performance' WHEN default_weekly_hours>40 AND avg_employee_performance_score>=80 THEN 'High Cost - High Performance' WHEN default_weekly_hours<=40 AND avg_employee_performance_score>=80 THEN 'Optimal Cost-Performance' ELSE 'Standard Cost-Performance' END cost_performance_analysis,
CASE WHEN current_workers_assigned=0 AND position_age_days>365 THEN 'Consider Position Elimination' WHEN similar_positions_in_department>5 THEN 'Consider Position Consolidation' WHEN flight_risk_employees_count>0 THEN 'Develop Succession Plan' WHEN avg_employee_performance_score>=90 THEN 'Consider Position Expansion' ELSE 'Maintain Current Structure' END strategic_recommendation,
CASE WHEN business_title IS NULL OR trim(business_title)='' THEN 'ERROR: Missing title' WHEN default_weekly_hours<=0 THEN 'ERROR: Invalid weekly hours' WHEN position_age_days<0 THEN 'ERROR: Future position date' WHEN default_weekly_hours>80 OR current_workers_assigned>3 THEN 'WARNING: Position anomaly' ELSE 'VALID' END data_quality_flag,current_timestamp::TIMESTAMPTZ analysis_timestamp

scopes.select_sql: SELECT *, CAST(DATE_DIFF('DAY', effective_start, CURRENT_DATE) AS BIGINT) AS position_age_days, COALESCE(last_assignment_date, effective_start) AS last_assignment_date_out, CASE WHEN REGEXP_EXTRACT(compensation_grade_id, '([0-9]+)', 1) = '' THEN 'Ungraded' WHEN TRY_CAST(REGEXP_EXTRACT(compensation_grade_id, '([0-9]+)', 1) AS INT) <= 5 THEN 'Entry Level' WHEN TRY_CAST(REGEXP_EXTRACT(compensation_grade_id, '([0-9]+)', 1) AS INT) <= 10 THEN 'Mid Level' WHEN TRY_CAST(REGEXP_EXTRACT(compensation_grade_id, '([0-9]+)', 1) AS INT) <= 15 THEN 'Senior Level' ELSE 'Executive Level' END AS compensation_tier FROM joined

cte_definitions.name: base
cte_definitions.sql: SELECT * FROM staging.stg_workday__position

cte_definitions.name: history
cte_definitions.sql: SELECT position_id, source_relation, COUNT(DISTINCT worker_id) AS total_workers_ever_assigned, COUNT(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE effective_end IS NULL) AS current_workers_assigned, COUNT(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE NOT effective_end IS NULL) AS former_workers_assigned, AVG(DATE_DIFF('DAY', effective_start, COALESCE(effective_end, CURRENT_DATE))) AS avg_tenure_days, MAX(effective_start) AS last_assignment_date, MAX(effective_end) AS last_departure_date, COUNT(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE effective_start >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1' YEAR) AS new_assignments_last_year, COUNT(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE effective_end >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1' YEAR) AS departures_last_year FROM staging.stg_workday__worker_position GROUP BY position_id, source_relation

cte_definitions.name: po
cte_definitions.sql: SELECT position_id, source_relation, organization_id, effective_end, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY position_id, source_relation ORDER BY effective_start DESC) AS rn FROM staging.stg_workday__position_organization

cte_definitions.name: profiles
cte_definitions.sql: SELECT pjp.position_id, pjp.source_relation, pjp.job_profile_id, jp.job_profile_title, jp.management_level, jp.compensation_grade_id, jp.is_work_shift_required, jp.is_union_eligible FROM staging.stg_workday__position_job_profile AS pjp LEFT JOIN staging.stg_workday__job_profile AS jp USING (job_profile_id, source_relation)

cte_definitions.name: orgs
cte_definitions.sql: SELECT organization_id, source_relation, organization_name, organization_type, organization_sub_type, staffing_model, current_employee_count, organization_health_score, annual_turnover_rate, performance_category, organization_size_category FROM intermediate.int_workday__organization_metrics

cte_definitions.name: similar_positions
cte_definitions.sql: SELECT po.organization_id, pr.job_profile_id, COUNT(DISTINCT b.position_id) AS similar_positions_in_department FROM base AS b LEFT JOIN po ON b.position_id = po.position_id AND b.source_relation = po.source_relation AND po.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN profiles AS pr ON b.position_id = pr.position_id AND b.source_relation = pr.source_relation GROUP BY po.organization_id, pr.job_profile_id

cte_definitions.name: emp
cte_definitions.sql: SELECT position_id, source_relation, AVG(overall_employee_score) FILTER(WHERE is_employed) AS avg_employee_performance_score, AVG(career_development_score) FILTER(WHERE is_employed) AS avg_career_development_score, AVG(retention_stability_score) FILTER(WHERE is_employed) AS avg_retention_score, COUNT(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE employee_risk_level = 'High Risk') AS high_risk_employees_count, COUNT(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE employee_risk_level = 'Medium Risk') AS medium_risk_employees_count, COUNT(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE employee_risk_level = 'Low Risk') AS low_risk_employees_count, COUNT(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE employee_value_segment = 'High Value - High Retention') AS high_value_employees_count, COUNT(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE employee_value_segment = 'High Value - Flight Risk') AS flight_risk_employees_count, COUNT(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE is_employed AND employee_maturity_segment LIKE '%New Hire%') AS new_employees_count, COUNT(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE is_employed AND employee_maturity_segment LIKE '%Veteran%') AS veteran_employees_count, AVG(age) FILTER(WHERE is_employed) AS avg_employee_age, COUNT(DISTINCT ethnicity_codes) FILTER(WHERE is_employed AND NOT ethnicity_codes IS NULL) AS ethnic_diversity_count, COUNT(DISTINCT worker_id) FILTER(WHERE is_employed AND is_military_service) AS military_veterans_count FROM mart.workday__employee_overview GROUP BY position_id, source_relation
